sentences.en: The chatty passenger beside me made the journey feel shorter.
sentences.zh: 我旁边那位健谈的乘客让旅途显得短了些。

sentences.en: A chatty writing style can make educational websites more welcoming, although complex ideas still require precise explanations.
sentences.zh: 聊天式的写作风格能让教育网站更亲切，但复杂概念仍需准确解释。

meaning.zh: （受雇为他人开车的）专职司机
meaning.en: a person employed to drive a car for someone else

sentences.en: The chauffeur opened the door for us.
sentences.zh: 专职司机为我们打开了车门。

sentences.en: A chauffeur was waiting outside the hotel to take the guests to the airport.
sentences.zh: 一名专职司机在酒店外等候，准备送客人去机场。

meaning.en: costing little money

sentences.en: These apples are cheap today.
sentences.zh: 今天这些苹果很便宜。

sentences.en: Cheap public transport can improve access to employment and reduce dependence on private cars in large cities.
sentences.zh: 价格低廉的公共交通能改善大城市居民的就业可达性，并减少对私家车的依赖。

meaning.en: to act dishonestly in order to gain an advantage, especially in a test or game

sentences.en: Do not cheat on the test.
sentences.zh: 考试不要作弊。

sentences.en: Schools can discourage students from cheating by designing assessments that reward original thinking rather than memorisation.
sentences.zh: 学校可以设计注重独立思考而非死记硬背的考核，减少学生作弊。

meaning.en: Dishonest behaviour intended to gain an unfair advantage.

sentences.en: Peeking at another player's cards is cheating, even among friends.
sentences.zh: 即使是朋友一起玩，偷看别人的牌也算作弊。

sentences.en: Schools can discourage cheating by designing assessments that reward independent thinking rather than the simple recall of facts.
sentences.zh: 学校可以设计重视独立思考而非单纯记忆事实的考核，以减少作弊。

meaning.en: to look at something to see if it is right or safe

sentences.en: Please check your answers.

meaning.en: an act of looking at something to make sure it is right or safe

meaning.zh: 办理入住/登机/报到手续
meaning.en: to register one's arrival at a hotel, airport, etc.

sentences.en: They check in after class.
sentences.zh: 他们下课后办理入住手续。

sentences.en: You should check in at least two hours before your flight.
sentences.zh: 你应该至少在航班起飞前两小时办理登机手续。

meaning.zh: 结账离开（酒店等）；查看；核实
meaning.en: to pay the bill and leave a hotel, etc.; to examine or verify something

sentences.en: They check out of the hotel after breakfast.
sentences.zh: 他们早饭后结账离开酒店。

sentences.en: You should check out the facts before making a decision.
sentences.zh: 在做决定之前，你应该核实一下事实。

meaning.zh: 登记入住；办理登机手续；签到
meaning.en: the act or process of registering arrival at a hotel, airport, event, etc.

sentences.en: Please go to the front desk for check-in.
sentences.zh: 请到前台办理入住手续。

sentences.en: Online check-in opens 24 hours before the flight.
sentences.zh: 网上值机在航班起飞前24小时开放。

meaning.en: The process of paying and leaving a hotel

sentences.en: We left our bags at reception after check-out.
sentences.zh: 退房后，我们把行李留在了前台。

sentences.en: Flexible check-out times can improve the travel experience for families with young children.
sentences.zh: 灵活的退房时间可以改善带幼儿出行家庭的旅行体验。

meaning.en: a medical examination to assess your general health

sentences.en: I booked a check-up because I felt unusually tired.
sentences.zh: 我因为感到异常疲倦，预约了一次体检。

sentences.en: Regular check-ups can help doctors detect health problems before they require more expensive treatment.
sentences.zh: 定期体检有助于医生在健康问题需要更昂贵的治疗之前发现它们。

meaning.en: a list of items to be checked or things to remember to do

sentences.en: Use this checklist before you leave.
sentences.zh: 离开前请使用这份核对清单。

sentences.en: A standard safety checklist can help hospital staff reduce avoidable errors during routine medical procedures.
sentences.zh: 标准安全检查表能帮助医院工作人员减少常规医疗操作中可避免的错误。

meaning.zh: 结账台；收银台；结账离开（如酒店退房）
meaning.en: the place where you pay for goods in a shop, or the act of paying and leaving a hotel

sentences.en: Please pay at the checkout.
sentences.zh: 请在收银台付款。

sentences.en: The hotel checkout time is 11 a.m.
sentences.zh: 酒店退房时间是上午11点。

meaning.en: either side of the face below the eyes

sentences.en: A cold raindrop fell on my cheek.
sentences.zh: 一滴冰凉的雨水落在了我的脸颊上。

sentences.en: Protective clothing should cover exposed areas, including the cheeks, when people work in extremely cold environments.
sentences.zh: 在极寒环境中工作时，防护服应遮住包括脸颊在内的裸露部位。

meaning.zh: 放肆却讨喜的；厚脸皮的
meaning.en: Slightly rude or disrespectful, often in an amusing way

sentences.en: The child gave a cheeky grin and took another biscuit.
sentences.zh: 那孩子调皮地咧嘴一笑，又拿了一块饼干。

sentences.en: Advertisements sometimes use cheeky humour to attract attention, although audiences may differ in what they find acceptable.
sentences.zh: 广告有时使用略带冒犯的幽默吸引注意，不过不同受众的接受尺度可能不同。

meaning.en: to shout loudly to show happiness or support for someone

sentences.en: We cheer for our school team.
sentences.zh: 我们为校队欢呼。

sentences.en: When spectators cheer for every participant, community sporting events can foster a stronger sense of belonging.
sentences.zh: 当观众为每位参与者喝彩时，社区体育活动能培养更强的归属感。

meaning.zh: 快活的；开朗的；令人愉快的
meaning.en: happy and positive; making you feel happy

sentences.en: The cheerful girl sang a song.
sentences.zh: 那个快活的女孩唱了一首歌。

sentences.en: A cheerful classroom atmosphere can encourage younger learners to participate more actively in group discussions.
sentences.zh: 愉快的课堂氛围能鼓励年幼的学习者更积极地参与小组讨论。

meaning.en: used as a toast to wish someone good luck or express good wishes before drinking

sentences.en: Cheers! Let's celebrate your graduation.
sentences.zh: 干杯！让我们庆祝你毕业。

sentences.en: He raised his glass and said, "Cheers to our friendship!"
sentences.zh: 他举起酒杯说：“为我们的友谊干杯！”

meaning.en: a solid food made from milk, usually yellow or white

sentences.en: Mice like to eat cheese.
sentences.zh: 老鼠喜欢吃奶酪。

sentences.en: Although cheese provides protein and calcium, some varieties contain high levels of salt and saturated fat.
sentences.zh: 虽然奶酪能提供蛋白质和钙，但有些品种的盐和饱和脂肪含量较高。

meaning.en: a large wild cat with a spotted coat that is known for its great speed

sentences.en: The cheetah runs across the grass.
sentences.zh: 猎豹跑过草地。

sentences.en: Cheetahs can reach speeds of over 100 kilometers per hour when chasing prey.
sentences.zh: 猎豹在追逐猎物时速度可超过每小时100公里。

meaning.en: a professional cook, especially the head cook in a restaurant

sentences.en: The chef cooked a fine dinner.
sentences.zh: 厨师做了一顿美味的晚餐。

sentences.en: A skilled chef can design nutritious school meals that appeal to children while staying within a limited budget.
sentences.zh: 技艺娴熟的厨师可以在有限预算内，设计出既营养又受孩子欢迎的学校餐食。

meaning.en: a substance produced by or used in chemistry

sentences.en: The chemical is in the glass bottle.
sentences.zh: 这种化学品在玻璃瓶里。

sentences.en: Farmers can protect nearby rivers by reducing the amount of agricultural chemicals used on their land.
sentences.zh: 农民可以通过减少农田中农业化学品的用量来保护附近的河流。

meaning.en: an expert in chemistry

sentences.en: The chemist mixed two liquids in the lab.
sentences.zh: 化学家在实验室里混合了两种液体。

sentences.en: Chemists are developing safer materials that could reduce the environmental impact of industrial production.
sentences.zh: 化学家正在研发更安全的材料，以减轻工业生产对环境的影响。

meaning.en: the scientific study of substances, their properties, and how they react with each other

sentences.en: We have chemistry class on Monday.
sentences.zh: 我们周一有化学课。

sentences.en: Understanding the chemistry of seawater helps scientists explain how rising carbon emissions affect marine life.
sentences.zh: 了解海水的化学特性有助于科学家解释碳排放增加如何影响海洋生物。

meaning.en: A written order directing a bank to pay a specified sum of money to a named person or entity.

sentences.en: He paid the bill by cheque.
sentences.zh: 他用支票支付了账单。

sentences.en: The bank refused to cash the cheque because the signature did not match.
sentences.zh: 银行拒绝兑现这张支票，因为签名不符。

meaning.en: A written instruction asking a bank to pay a specified amount.

sentences.en: My grandmother sent me a cheque for my birthday.
sentences.zh: 奶奶寄给我一张支票作为生日礼物。

sentences.en: Although digital payments are increasingly common, some businesses still accept a cheque from customers.
sentences.zh: 尽管数字支付日益普及，一些企业仍接受顾客用支票付款。

meaning.zh: 珍爱；珍惜；怀有（希望、记忆等）
meaning.en: to love and value something highly and keep it in mind with care

sentences.en: Parents cherish every moment with their children.
sentences.zh: 父母珍惜与孩子在一起的每一刻。

sentences.en: She cherishes the memory of her grandmother's stories.
sentences.zh: 她珍藏着对祖母讲故事的回忆。

meaning.en: small round red fruits with stones; plural of cherry

sentences.en: These cherries are red and sweet.
sentences.zh: 这些樱桃又红又甜。

sentences.en: She bought a bag of cherries at the market.
sentences.zh: 她在市场上买了一袋樱桃。

meaning.en: A small round fruit with a stone and usually red skin

sentences.en: He placed a ripe cherry on top of the cake.
sentences.zh: 他在蛋糕顶上放了一颗熟透的樱桃。

sentences.en: Cherry trees attract visitors during spring, providing seasonal income for rural communities through tourism.
sentences.zh: 樱花树在春季吸引游客，通过旅游业为乡村社区带来季节性收入。

meaning.en: the pink or white flower of a cherry tree

sentences.en: We see a cherry blossom in the park.
sentences.zh: 我们在公园里看到一朵樱花。

sentences.en: The cherry blossoms along the river attract many tourists every spring.
sentences.zh: 每年春天河边的樱花吸引许多游客。

meaning.en: a board game for two players

sentences.en: Grandpa teaches me to play chess.
sentences.zh: 爷爷教我下国际象棋。

sentences.en: Playing chess regularly may help children develop concentration and practise planning several steps ahead.
sentences.zh: 经常下国际象棋可能有助于儿童提高专注力，并练习提前规划多个步骤。

meaning.en: the front part of the body between the neck and the stomach

sentences.en: She held the sleeping cat gently against her chest.
sentences.zh: 她把熟睡的小猫轻轻抱在胸前。

sentences.en: Workers exposed to polluted air may develop chest problems, highlighting the importance of effective workplace ventilation.
sentences.zh: 接触污染空气的工人可能出现胸部疾病，这凸显了工作场所有效通风的重要性。

meaning.en: a brown nut with a pointed top, or the tree that produces it

sentences.en: The children collected chestnuts in the park.
sentences.zh: 孩子们在公园里捡栗子。

sentences.en: Roasted chestnuts are a popular winter snack in many cities.
sentences.zh: 烤栗子是许多城市里受欢迎的冬季小吃。

meaning.en: to use your teeth to break food into smaller pieces before swallowing

sentences.en: Please chew the food slowly.
sentences.zh: 请慢慢咀嚼食物。

sentences.en: Children should be encouraged to chew food thoroughly and develop healthy eating habits from an early age.
sentences.zh: 应鼓励儿童充分咀嚼食物，从小养成健康的饮食习惯。

meaning.en: A baby bird, especially a young chicken.

sentences.en: A yellow chick followed the hen across the yard.
sentences.zh: 一只黄色小鸡跟着母鸡穿过院子。

sentences.en: Conservation teams monitor each newly hatched chick to assess whether habitat restoration is improving breeding success.
sentences.zh: 保护团队监测每只刚孵化的雏鸟，以评估栖息地修复是否提高了繁殖成功率。

meaning.en: a farm bird kept for its eggs or meat, or the meat from this bird

sentences.en: The chicken lays an egg.
sentences.zh: 这只鸡下了一个蛋。

sentences.en: Replacing some red meat with chicken can reduce the environmental impact of a person's diet.
sentences.zh: 用鸡肉替代部分红肉，可以减少个人饮食对环境的影响。

meaning.en: to criticize or scold someone mildly for a fault

sentences.en: Do not chide the child so harshly.
sentences.zh: 不要这么严厉地责备那个孩子。

sentences.en: She chided herself for not speaking up at the meeting.
sentences.zh: 她责怪自己在会上没有大胆发言。

meaning.en: the leader of a group, organization, or community

sentences.en: The chief of the village is wise.
sentences.zh: 这个村庄的首领很睿智。

sentences.en: The chief advantage of public transport is its ability to move large crowds while using less road space.
sentences.zh: 公共交通的主要优势在于能用较少的道路空间运送大量乘客。

meaning.en: a young boy or girl

sentences.en: The child holds a red balloon.
sentences.zh: 那个孩子拿着一个红气球。

sentences.en: Every child should have access to quality education, regardless of family income or place of residence.
sentences.zh: 每个孩子都应享有优质教育，不论其家庭收入或居住地点如何。

meaning.en: the state or time of being a child

sentences.en: She had a happy childhood at home.
sentences.zh: 她在家度过了快乐的童年。

sentences.en: Access to safe outdoor spaces during childhood can support physical development and emotional wellbeing.
sentences.zh: 童年时期能够使用安全的户外空间，有助于身体发育和心理健康。

meaning.en: Behaving immaturely in a way unsuitable for an adult.

sentences.en: Hiding my shoes was a childish thing to do.
sentences.zh: 把我的鞋藏起来，这种做法很幼稚。

sentences.en: Dismissing young people's concerns as childish can discourage them from participating in discussions about their communities.
sentences.zh: 将年轻人的关切斥为幼稚，可能会使他们不愿参与有关社区事务的讨论。

meaning.en: Young people who have not yet become adults.

sentences.en: The children built a sandcastle together on the beach.
sentences.zh: 孩子们一起在海滩上堆了一座沙堡。

sentences.en: Safe public parks give children opportunities to exercise, develop social skills, and explore the natural world.
sentences.zh: 安全的公共公园为儿童提供了锻炼身体、发展社交技能和探索自然的机会。

meaning.zh: 辣椒（常用于烹饪的辛辣辣椒）
meaning.en: a hot pepper used in cooking

sentences.en: This soup has too much chili in it.
sentences.zh: 这汤里放的辣椒太多了。

sentences.en: She added chopped chili and garlic to the sauce for extra flavor.
sentences.zh: 她在酱汁里加了切碎的辣椒和大蒜以增加风味。

meaning.en: A feeling of cold in the air or in someone's body.

sentences.en: There was a chill in the air this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早晨空气中透着一股寒意。

sentences.en: She felt a chill run down her spine as she walked through the empty house.
sentences.zh: 她走过空荡荡的房子时，感到一阵寒意顺着脊背而下。

meaning.en: to relax and stop worrying

sentences.en: They chill out after class.
sentences.zh: 他们下课后放松一下。

sentences.en: After a long week at work, I like to chill out by listening to music.
sentences.zh: 工作了一周后，我喜欢听音乐来放松。

meaning.en: a small pepper with a strong, hot taste

sentences.en: Add one chopped chilli if you like spicy food.
sentences.zh: 如果你喜欢吃辣，就加一根切碎的辣椒。

sentences.en: Farmers growing chilli peppers may need reliable irrigation systems as rising temperatures increase water demand.
sentences.zh: 随着气温上升导致需水量增加，辣椒种植户可能需要可靠的灌溉系统。

meaning.zh: 寒冷的；冷得让人不舒服的
meaning.en: cold enough to feel uncomfortable

sentences.en: It is chilly outside this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上外面有点冷。

sentences.en: Providing warm public spaces during chilly weather can help protect older residents from cold-related illnesses.
sentences.zh: 在寒冷天气提供温暖的公共场所，有助于保护老年居民免受寒冷引发的疾病侵害。

meaning.en: a ringing sound made by a bell or set of bells

sentences.en: Church bells chime at noon each day.
sentences.zh: 教堂的钟每天中午鸣响。

sentences.en: The gentle chime of the clock echoed through the quiet hall.
sentences.zh: 钟的轻柔鸣响声在安静的大厅里回荡。

meaning.en: a vertical structure that carries smoke and gases away from a fire or furnace

sentences.en: Smoke rose from the old chimney.
sentences.zh: 烟从旧烟囱里升起。

sentences.en: Installing filters in factory chimneys can reduce the amount of harmful particles released into the atmosphere.
sentences.zh: 在工厂烟囱中安装过滤装置，可以减少排入大气的有害颗粒物。

meaning.en: a highly intelligent ape that lives in African forests and is closely related to humans

sentences.en: The chimpanzee eats a banana.
sentences.zh: 这只黑猩猩吃香蕉。

sentences.en: Scientists have observed chimpanzees using tools in the wild.
sentences.zh: 科学家观察到黑猩猩在野外使用工具。

meaning.en: The part of your face below your mouth.

sentences.en: He rested his chin on his hand and sighed.
sentences.zh: 他用手托着下巴，叹了口气。

sentences.en: Cyclists should adjust helmet straps beneath the chin to ensure a secure fit during travel.
sentences.zh: 骑车者应调节下巴下方的头盔带，确保骑行时头盔佩戴牢固。

meaning.en: porcelain or ceramic ware

sentences.en: She keeps her grandmother's china in a glass cabinet.
sentences.zh: 她把祖母的瓷器放在玻璃柜里。

sentences.en: The museum's collection of fine china dates back to the 18th century.
sentences.zh: 博物馆收藏的精美瓷器可追溯到18世纪。

meaning.zh: 中国的；中国人的；汉语的
meaning.en: relating to China, its people, or its language

sentences.en: We had Chinese dumplings at a small restaurant yesterday.
sentences.zh: 昨天我们在一家小餐馆吃了中式饺子。

sentences.en: Learning Chinese can help international students develop a deeper understanding of cultural traditions in China.
sentences.zh: 学习汉语可以帮助国际学生更深入地了解中国的文化传统。

meaning.en: the Chinese language, or a person from China

sentences.en: She speaks Chinese and English.
sentences.zh: 她会说汉语和英语。

sentences.en: Many Chinese have moved to cities in recent decades.
sentences.zh: 近几十年来，许多中国人搬到了城市。

meaning.en: a thin fried piece of potato

sentences.en: He drops a chip on the plate.
sentences.zh: 他把一根薯条掉在了盘子上。

sentences.en: The children shared a large bag of chips after school.
sentences.zh: 孩子们放学后分享了一大袋薯条。

meaning.en: a small electronic device used in computers and other machines

sentences.en: The repairman replaced a damaged chip inside my laptop.
sentences.zh: 维修人员更换了我笔记本电脑内部一块损坏的芯片。

sentences.en: Demand for advanced chips is increasing as more industries adopt artificial intelligence and automated production systems.
sentences.zh: 随着更多行业采用人工智能和自动化生产系统，对先进芯片的需求正在增长。

meaning.zh: 花栗鼠（一种小型带条纹的啮齿动物）
meaning.en: a small striped rodent that stores nuts

sentences.en: A chipmunk hides nuts in autumn.
sentences.zh: 一只花栗鼠在秋天藏坚果。

sentences.en: We saw a chipmunk dart across the trail and disappear into the underbrush.
sentences.zh: 我们看到一只花栗鼠飞快地穿过小径，消失在灌木丛中。

meaning.en: long thin pieces of potato fried in oil, usually eaten hot

sentences.en: I ordered a burger and chips for lunch.
sentences.zh: 我午餐点了一个汉堡和一份薯条。

sentences.en: Schools can encourage healthier eating by replacing chips with vegetables and other nutritious side dishes.
sentences.zh: 学校可以用蔬菜和其他营养配菜替代薯条，鼓励更健康的饮食。

meaning.zh: （鸟或昆虫）发出短促尖细的叫声；唧唧叫
meaning.en: to make a short, high-pitched sound, especially like a small bird or insect

sentences.en: The birds chirp outside my window every morning.
sentences.zh: 每天早晨鸟儿在我窗外唧唧叫。

sentences.en: Crickets chirped softly in the grass as we walked through the field.
sentences.zh: 我们走过田野时，蟋蟀在草丛中轻声鸣叫。

meaning.en: a tool with a sharp edge for cutting stone or wood

sentences.en: He cut the stone with a chisel.
sentences.zh: 他用凿子凿石头。

sentences.en: Traditional craftspeople use a chisel to create detailed patterns that preserve local artistic traditions.
sentences.zh: 传统手艺人用凿子雕出精细图案，传承当地的艺术传统。

meaning.en: a sweet brown food made from cocoa beans

sentences.en: He shared a bar of chocolate with his sister.
sentences.zh: 他和妹妹分享了一块巧克力。

sentences.en: Consumers increasingly expect chocolate producers to ensure fair wages and safe working conditions throughout their supply chains.
sentences.zh: 消费者越来越期望巧克力生产商确保整个供应链中的公平工资和安全工作条件。

meaning.en: the act of choosing between two or more possibilities, or one of the things you can choose

sentences.en: You have a choice of two books.
sentences.zh: 你有两本书可选。

sentences.en: Reliable public transport gives commuters a wider choice and reduces their dependence on private cars.
sentences.zh: 可靠的公共交通为通勤者提供更多选择，并减少他们对私家车的依赖。

meaning.en: a group of people who sing together, especially in a church or school

sentences.en: The school choir sang a gentle song.
sentences.zh: 学校合唱队唱了一首轻柔的歌。

sentences.en: Joining a community choir can reduce loneliness and strengthen social connections among older adults.
sentences.zh: 加入社区合唱团可以减轻老年人的孤独感，并加强他们的社会联系。

meaning.en: to be unable to breathe because your airway is blocked

sentences.en: He began to choke on a piece of bread.
sentences.zh: 他吃面包时噎住了。

sentences.en: The smoke was so thick that we nearly choked.
sentences.zh: 烟太浓了，我们几乎窒息。

meaning.en: a fatty substance found in the body and in some foods

sentences.en: Too much cholesterol is bad for the heart.
sentences.zh: 胆固醇过高对心脏有害。

sentences.en: Eating too many fried foods can raise your cholesterol level.
sentences.zh: 吃太多油炸食品会升高你的胆固醇水平。

meaning.en: to decide which one you want from two or more possibilities

sentences.en: Please choose a book to read.
sentences.zh: 请选一本书来读。

sentences.en: Many students choose to study abroad because they want to experience different cultures and teaching methods.
sentences.zh: 许多学生选择出国留学，因为他们想体验不同的文化和教学方法。

meaning.en: to cut something into smaller pieces

sentences.en: I'll heat the soup; please chop the carrots.
sentences.zh: 我来热汤，请你把胡萝卜切碎。

sentences.en: When communities chop down trees for fuel, they may unintentionally damage habitats and increase soil erosion.
sentences.zh: 当社区居民砍树用作燃料时，他们可能无意中破坏栖息地，加剧水土流失。

meaning.en: two thin sticks used for picking up food, especially in East Asian countries

sentences.en: I eat rice with chopsticks.
sentences.zh: 我用筷子吃米饭。

sentences.en: In many Asian cultures, using chopsticks correctly is considered good table manners.
sentences.zh: 在许多亚洲文化中，正确使用筷子被视为良好的餐桌礼仪。

meaning.en: three or more musical notes played together

sentences.en: She played a bright chord.
sentences.zh: 她弹了一个明亮的和弦。

sentences.en: The song begins with a simple chord progression.
sentences.zh: 这首歌以一个简单的和弦进行开始。

meaning.en: a small routine task, especially a household one

sentences.en: Washing dishes is my evening chore.
sentences.zh: 洗碗是我晚上的家务活。

sentences.en: She divides the household chores equally among her children.
sentences.zh: 她把家务活平均分配给孩子们。

meaning.en: to design and arrange the steps and movements of a dance

sentences.en: They choreograph a new dance.
sentences.zh: 他们为一支新舞蹈编舞。

sentences.en: She was invited to choreograph the opening ceremony.
sentences.zh: 她受邀为开幕式编舞。

meaning.en: A repeated section of a song, usually with unchanged words.

sentences.en: Everyone sang along during the chorus.
sentences.zh: 唱到副歌时，大家都跟着唱了起来。

sentences.en: A memorable chorus can help environmental campaign songs reach wider audiences and encourage participation in community activities.
sentences.zh: 令人难忘的副歌可以帮助环保宣传歌曲吸引更广泛的听众，并鼓励人们参与社区活动。

meaning.zh: 基督（耶稣基督；亦作 Christ）
meaning.en: the title given to Jesus, regarded by Christians as the Messiah

sentences.en: Christ is the central figure of Christianity.
sentences.zh: 基督是基督教的核心人物。

sentences.en: The painting depicts Christ surrounded by his disciples.
sentences.zh: 这幅画描绘了基督被门徒环绕的场景。

meaning.en: a person who believes in Christianity

sentences.en: My neighbor is a Christian and goes to church every Sunday.
sentences.zh: 我的邻居是基督徒，每个星期天都去教堂。

sentences.en: Christian charities, alongside other religious and secular organisations, provide essential support for vulnerable communities in many countries.
sentences.zh: 在许多国家，基督教慈善机构与其他宗教及世俗组织一起，为弱势群体提供重要支持。

meaning.en: relating to Christianity or its followers

sentences.en: She attends a Christian church in the city center.
sentences.zh: 她在市中心参加一座基督教教堂。

meaning.en: a Christian holiday celebrated on December 25, or the period around it

sentences.en: We give gifts at Christmas.
sentences.zh: 我们在圣诞节送礼物。

sentences.en: During Christmas, increased consumer spending can benefit local shops, although it may also generate additional packaging waste.
sentences.zh: 圣诞节期间，消费支出的增加可以使当地商店受益，但也可能产生更多包装废弃物。

meaning.en: a thread-like structure in the nucleus of a cell that carries genes

sentences.en: Each cell has a pair of chromosomes.
sentences.zh: 每个细胞都有一对染色体。

sentences.en: Scientists studied the chromosomes to find the gene responsible for the disease.
sentences.zh: 科学家研究染色体以寻找导致该疾病的基因。

meaning.en: lasting a long time or recurring often

sentences.en: He has a chronic pain in his back.
sentences.zh: 他背部有慢性疼痛。

sentences.en: Chronic staff shortages can reduce the quality of healthcare and increase pressure on existing medical workers.
sentences.zh: 长期人员短缺会降低医疗服务质量，并增加现有医护人员的压力。

meaning.en: in a way that continues for a long time and is difficult to cure or stop

sentences.en: He has been chronically ill for years.
sentences.zh: 他多年来一直患有慢性病。

sentences.en: The city is chronically short of affordable housing.
sentences.zh: 这座城市长期缺乏经济适用房。

meaning.en: a written record of events in the order they happened

sentences.en: The book is a chronicle of the war.
sentences.zh: 这本书是一部战争编年史。

sentences.en: Her diary serves as a chronicle of daily life in the 19th century.
sentences.zh: 她的日记是19世纪日常生活的记录。

meaning.en: arranged in the time order that events happened

sentences.en: Put the photos in chronological order.
sentences.zh: 把这些照片按时间先后排列。

sentences.en: Presenting historical events in chronological order helps students understand how earlier developments influenced later social changes.
sentences.zh: 按时间顺序呈现历史事件，有助于学生理解早期发展如何影响后来的社会变迁。

meaning.en: The order in which events happen in time; a record of this order.

sentences.en: These family photos helped us establish the chronology.
sentences.zh: 这些家庭照片帮助我们确定了事情发生的先后顺序。

sentences.en: Establishing an accurate chronology allows historians to examine how environmental changes influenced the development of early settlements.
sentences.zh: 建立准确的事件时间序列，有助于历史学家研究环境变化如何影响早期聚落的发展。

meaning.en: to throw something carelessly or casually

sentences.en: Chuck the ball to me across the yard.
sentences.zh: 把球从院子那边扔给我。

sentences.en: He chucked his coat onto the chair and sat down.
sentences.zh: 他把外套扔到椅子上，然后坐了下来。

meaning.en: to laugh quietly, especially in a relaxed or amused way

sentences.en: He gave a little chuckle.
sentences.zh: 他轻声笑了一下。

sentences.en: She chuckled to herself as she read the funny message.
sentences.zh: 她读着那条有趣的信息，暗自轻笑。

meaning.zh: 好友，伙伴（非正式，尤指男性之间）
meaning.en: a close friend, especially a male friend (informal)

sentences.en: He went fishing with his old chum.
sentences.zh: 他和老朋友一起去钓鱼。

sentences.en: After work, he often meets up with his chums for a drink.
sentences.zh: 下班后，他经常和朋友们聚在一起喝一杯。

meaning.en: a thick, solid piece of something

sentences.en: He ate a chunk of bread with cheese.
sentences.zh: 他吃了一块面包配奶酪。

sentences.en: Housing costs consume a large chunk of household income, leaving less money for education and leisure.
sentences.zh: 住房开支占据了家庭收入的很大一部分，使可用于教育和休闲的钱减少了。

meaning.en: a building used for Christian worship and religious services

sentences.en: We visit the old church on Sunday.
sentences.zh: 我们星期天去参观那座古老的教堂。

sentences.en: Preserving a historic church can protect local heritage while providing opportunities for education and tourism.
sentences.zh: 保护历史悠久的教堂既能保护当地文化遗产，也能为教育和旅游创造机会。

meaning.en: to move liquid or a substance around with force, often causing it to swirl

sentences.en: Waves churn the water near the rocks.
sentences.zh: 海浪在岩石附近搅动着海水。

sentences.en: The machine churns the milk to make butter.
sentences.zh: 这台机器搅动牛奶来制作黄油。

meaning.en: a thick roll of dried tobacco leaves made for smoking

sentences.en: He took a cigar out of the small wooden box.
sentences.zh: 他从那个小木盒里拿出一支雪茄。

sentences.en: Public health campaigns should explain that smoking cigars also carries serious risks to health.
sentences.zh: 公共卫生宣传应说明，抽雪茄同样会严重危害健康。

meaning.en: a thin tube of paper filled with tobacco, that people smoke

sentences.en: He lit a cigarette and walked outside.
sentences.zh: 他点了一支香烟，然后走了出去。

sentences.en: The government has introduced stricter rules on cigarette advertising.
sentences.zh: 政府出台了更严格的香烟广告规定。

meaning.en: a roll of tobacco people smoke

sentences.en: Cigarettes are bad for you.
sentences.zh: 香烟对你有害。

sentences.en: Higher cigarette taxes may discourage smoking, but accessible support services are also essential for people trying to quit.
sentences.zh: 提高香烟税可能有助于减少吸烟，但对尝试戒烟的人来说，便捷的支持服务也必不可少。

meaning.en: a building where films are shown to the public

sentences.en: We watched a film at the cinema.
sentences.zh: 我们在电影院看了一部电影。

sentences.en: International cinema allows audiences to explore unfamiliar cultures and consider social issues from different perspectives.
sentences.zh: 国际电影让观众能够了解陌生的文化，并从不同角度思考社会问题。

meaning.en: the art or industry of making films

sentences.en: International cinema allows audiences to explore unfamiliar cultures and consider social issues from different perspectives.
sentences.zh: 国际电影让观众能够了解陌生的文化，并从不同角度思考社会问题。

meaning.en: a round shape consisting of a curved line that completely encloses a space

sentences.en: Draw a big circle on the paper.
sentences.zh: 在纸上画一个大圆圈。

sentences.en: Joining community activities can help older adults expand their social circle and reduce feelings of isolation.
sentences.zh: 参加社区活动可以帮助老年人扩大社交圈，减少孤独感。

meaning.en: a path that electricity follows

sentences.en: This circuit is not complete.
sentences.zh: 这个电路不完整。

sentences.en: Students can develop practical scientific skills by building a simple circuit and testing different materials.
sentences.zh: 学生可以通过搭建简单电路并测试不同材料来培养科学实践技能。

meaning.en: Shaped like a circle or following a round path.

sentences.en: We placed a circular rug under the coffee table.
sentences.zh: 我们在茶几下面铺了一块圆形地毯。

sentences.en: A circular economy aims to reduce waste by keeping materials in use for as long as possible.
sentences.zh: 循环经济旨在通过尽可能延长材料的使用时间来减少浪费。

meaning.en: to move continuously around a place or system

sentences.en: Blood must circulate through the body.
sentences.zh: 血液必须在体内循环。

sentences.en: The heart pumps blood to circulate oxygen and nutrients throughout the body.
sentences.zh: 心脏泵血，使氧气和营养物质在全身循环。

meaning.en: the movement of blood around the body

sentences.en: Regular exercise improves blood circulation.
sentences.zh: 经常锻炼能改善血液循环。

sentences.en: Poor circulation can make your hands and feet feel cold.
sentences.zh: 血液循环不良会使手脚发冷。

meaning.en: the distance around the edge of a circle, or the edge itself

sentences.en: The circumference of the circle is about 31 centimeters.
sentences.zh: 这个圆的周长约为31厘米。

sentences.en: To find the circumference, multiply the diameter by pi.
sentences.zh: 要求周长，就用直径乘以圆周率。

meaning.zh: 限制，约束；在……周围画线，圈定
meaning.en: to limit or restrict something; to draw a line around something

sentences.en: Rules circumscribe our freedom.
sentences.zh: 规则限制了我们的自由。

sentences.en: The new regulations circumscribe the powers of local authorities.
sentences.zh: 新法规限制了地方当局的权力。

meaning.en: a fact or condition that affects a situation

sentences.en: In this circumstance we must wait.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，我们必须等待。

sentences.en: Schools should consider each student's personal circumstances when developing policies on attendance and access to learning resources.
sentences.zh: 学校制定出勤和学习资源获取政策时，应考虑每位学生的个人情况。

meaning.en: to find a way around a rule, problem, or difficulty

sentences.en: Do not circumvent the safety rule.
sentences.zh: 不要规避安全规定。

sentences.en: Some companies try to circumvent the tax law by moving their profits overseas.
sentences.zh: 一些公司试图通过将利润转移到海外来规避税法。

meaning.en: a group of performers, often traveling, who entertain people with acts such as acrobatics, clowns, and animals

sentences.en: We watched the circus last night.
sentences.zh: 我们昨晚看了马戏表演。

sentences.en: Modern circus performances can preserve traditional entertainment skills while creating opportunities for artists from diverse backgrounds.
sentences.zh: 现代马戏表演既能保留传统娱乐技艺，也能为不同背景的艺术工作者创造机会。

meaning.en: a quotation from or reference to a book, paper, or author, especially in academic work

sentences.en: The essay includes a citation from a famous speech.
sentences.zh: 这篇文章引用了一段著名演讲中的话。

sentences.en: Please check that every citation in your paper follows the required format.
sentences.zh: 请检查你论文中的每一条引文是否都符合要求的格式。

meaning.en: to quote or refer to (a book, author, etc.) as evidence or support

sentences.en: Please cite the book in your report.
sentences.zh: 请注明你做项目时参考的那本书。

sentences.en: Researchers often cite access to green spaces as an important factor in improving urban residents' mental health.
sentences.zh: 研究人员经常指出，能否方便地使用绿地是改善城市居民心理健康的重要因素。

meaning.en: a person who has the right to belong to a particular country

sentences.en: Every citizen should follow the law.
sentences.zh: 每个公民都应遵守法律。

sentences.en: Every citizen should have access to reliable public services, regardless of income or place of residence.
sentences.zh: 每位公民都应享有可靠的公共服务，不论收入多少或居住在哪里。

meaning.en: the legal status of belonging to a particular country

sentences.en: She applied for citizenship after living here for years.
sentences.zh: 在这里生活多年后，她申请了公民身份。

sentences.en: Citizenship education can help young people understand their rights and responsibilities while encouraging active participation in democratic processes.
sentences.zh: 公民教育能帮助年轻人理解自己的权利与责任，同时鼓励他们积极参与民主进程。

meaning.zh: 柑橘类果树；柑橘类水果
meaning.en: Trees producing fruits such as oranges and lemons, or their fruits.

sentences.en: We squeezed fresh citrus juice over the salad.
sentences.zh: 我们在沙拉上挤了一些新鲜的柑橘类果汁。

sentences.en: Rising temperatures may affect citrus production by increasing water demand and exposing orchards to new pests.
sentences.zh: 气温上升可能增加需水量，并使果园面临新的虫害，从而影响柑橘生产。

meaning.en: a large town with many streets and people

sentences.en: We live in a big city.
sentences.zh: 我们住在一座大城市里。

sentences.en: A well-designed city provides accessible public transport and green spaces that improve residents' quality of life.
sentences.zh: 一座规划良好的城市会提供便利的公共交通和绿地，改善居民的生活质量。

meaning.en: the central part of a city, especially its main commercial or cultural area

sentences.en: We walked around the city centre and visited the main shops.
sentences.zh: 我们在市中心逛了逛，去了主要的商店。

sentences.en: The new library is in the city centre, close to the train station.
sentences.zh: 新图书馆位于市中心，靠近火车站。

meaning.en: relating to a town and its people

sentences.en: Voting is a civic duty.
sentences.zh: 投票是一项公民义务。

sentences.en: Schools can strengthen civic responsibility by encouraging students to participate in projects that benefit their local communities.
sentences.zh: 学校可以鼓励学生参与造福当地社区的项目，以增强他们的公民责任感。

meaning.en: Relating to citizens or ordinary society rather than the military or church.

sentences.en: The airport serves both military and civil aircraft.
sentences.zh: 这座机场既接待军用飞机，也接待民用飞机。

sentences.en: Protecting civil rights requires accessible legal services and public institutions that treat all citizens fairly.
sentences.zh: 保护公民权利需要便捷可及的法律服务，以及公平对待所有公民的公共机构。

meaning.zh: 平民的；非军事（或非警察）的
meaning.en: of a person who is not a member of the military or police

sentences.en: He wore civilian clothes, not a uniform.
sentences.zh: 他穿着便服，而不是制服。

sentences.en: Satellite technology originally developed for military purposes now supports many civilian applications, including weather forecasting and navigation.
sentences.zh: 最初为军事目的开发的卫星技术，如今支持天气预报和导航等多种民用应用。

meaning.en: the society and culture of a particular people or nation

sentences.en: The old civilization built great cities.
sentences.zh: 这个古老文明建造了宏伟的城市。

sentences.en: Reliable water supplies played a crucial role in the development of civilization by supporting agriculture and permanent settlements.
sentences.zh: 可靠的水源支持了农业和固定聚落的发展，在文明形成过程中发挥了关键作用。

meaning.en: to make people behave more politely or develop organized societies

sentences.en: My aunt jokes that dancing lessons will civilize me.
sentences.zh: 姑妈开玩笑说，舞蹈课会让我变得有教养。

sentences.en: Historical claims that foreign rule would civilize local populations often concealed unequal power relations and cultural prejudice.
sentences.zh: 历史上所谓外来统治能使当地民众文明化的说法，往往掩盖了不平等的权力关系和文化偏见。

meaning.en: polite, well-educated, and showing good behavior

sentences.en: A civilized city needs fair laws.
sentences.zh: 一个文明的城市需要公平的法律。

sentences.en: It is important to have a civilized discussion even when people disagree.
sentences.zh: 即使人们意见不同，进行文明的讨论也很重要。

meaning.en: to say that something is true, often without proof

sentences.en: They claim the bag is theirs.
sentences.zh: 他们声称这个包是他们的。

sentences.en: Some researchers claim that access to green spaces can improve mental health and strengthen community relationships.
sentences.zh: 一些研究人员认为，能够使用绿地有助于改善心理健康并加强社区联系。

meaning.en: A shellfish with two joined shells, often living buried in sand.

sentences.en: We found a clam buried in the wet sand.
sentences.zh: 我们在湿沙里发现了一只蛤蜊。

sentences.en: Clam farming can support coastal economies, but poor water quality may threaten both shellfish and consumers.
sentences.zh: 蛤蜊养殖可以支撑沿海经济，但水质不佳可能同时威胁贝类和消费者。

meaning.en: to climb or move up, over, or down something with difficulty, using both hands and feet

sentences.en: The boys clamber up the rocks.
sentences.zh: 男孩们手脚并用地攀上岩石。

sentences.en: She clambered over the wall to get into the garden.
sentences.zh: 她费力地爬过墙进入花园。

meaning.en: a loud confused noise of voices

sentences.en: A clamor rose from the angry crowd.
sentences.zh: 愤怒的人群中爆发出一阵喧哗。

sentences.en: Public clamor for cleaner air has encouraged local authorities to invest in more reliable public transport.
sentences.zh: 公众要求改善空气质量的强烈呼声，推动地方政府投资建设更可靠的公共交通。

meaning.en: to hold or fasten something tightly, often with a tool or device

sentences.en: Please clamp the two boards together.
sentences.zh: 请把这两块木板夹紧在一起。

sentences.en: During laboratory tests, researchers clamp each sample securely to prevent movement from affecting the accuracy of measurements.
sentences.zh: 在实验室测试中，研究人员将每个样本夹紧固定，防止移动影响测量准确性。

meaning.zh: 氏族，宗族；（尤指苏格兰的）家族；大家族
meaning.en: a group of families or households claiming descent from a common ancestor, especially in Scotland; a large family group

sentences.en: The clan met once a year.
sentences.zh: 这个宗族每年聚会一次。

sentences.en: In traditional societies, loyalty to the clan often came before loyalty to the state.
sentences.zh: 在传统社会中，对宗族的忠诚往往先于对国家的忠诚。

meaning.en: to make a short, loud noise by hitting your hands together

sentences.en: Please clap after the short play.
sentences.zh: 短剧结束后，请鼓掌。

sentences.en: Audiences often clap after live performances to express appreciation for the skill and effort of the artists.
sentences.zh: 现场演出结束后，观众常常鼓掌，以表达对艺术家技艺和付出的赞赏。

meaning.en: an explanation that makes something clearer or easier to understand

sentences.en: I asked for clarification before signing the rental agreement.
sentences.zh: 签租房合同前，我要求对方进一步说明。

sentences.en: Students benefit from clarification of assessment criteria before they begin complex research assignments at university.
sentences.zh: 大学生在开始复杂的研究作业前，若评分标准得到明确说明，会更有帮助。

meaning.en: to make something easier to understand

sentences.en: Please clarify the last question for the class.
sentences.zh: 请为全班澄清最后一个问题。

sentences.en: Governments should clarify how personal data will be used before introducing digital identity systems.
sentences.zh: 政府在推行数字身份系统前，应阐明个人数据将如何使用。

meaning.en: A woodwind instrument with a single reed and finger-operated keys.

sentences.en: My sister practises the clarinet quietly after dinner.
sentences.zh: 我姐姐晚饭后轻声练习单簧管。

sentences.en: Learning to play the clarinet can help children develop concentration while encouraging participation in school orchestras.
sentences.zh: 学习吹奏单簧管能帮助儿童培养专注力，同时鼓励他们参加学校管弦乐团。

meaning.en: The quality of being clear and easy to understand.

sentences.en: I appreciate the clarity of your instructions for this game.
sentences.zh: 你把这个游戏的玩法说明得很清楚，我很喜欢。

sentences.en: Greater clarity in public health advice can help people make informed decisions about their daily habits.
sentences.zh: 更清晰的公共卫生建议能帮助人们在日常习惯方面作出明智决定。

meaning.en: to fight or disagree strongly; to be in conflict

sentences.en: The two teams clash on Sunday.
sentences.zh: 两支队伍将在周日交锋。

sentences.en: A clash between economic priorities and environmental goals can delay decisions about major infrastructure projects.
sentences.zh: 经济优先事项与环境目标之间的冲突可能延误重大基础设施项目的决策。

meaning.en: to hold something tightly with your hand, or to fasten something with a clasp

sentences.en: She will clasp the bag shut.
sentences.zh: 她会把包扣紧。

sentences.en: Young children may clasp a familiar toy during medical appointments because it provides comfort in unfamiliar surroundings.
sentences.zh: 幼儿就诊时可能会紧抱熟悉的玩具，因为它能在陌生环境中带来安慰。

meaning.en: a group of students who are taught together; a period of teaching

sentences.en: Our class starts at eight.
sentences.zh: 我们班正在学习如何种蔬菜。

sentences.en: Smaller class sizes may allow teachers to give more individual attention to students with learning difficulties.
sentences.zh: 较小的班级规模可能让教师给予学习有困难的学生更多个别关注。

meaning.en: having a high quality or standard of lasting value; serving as a typical example

sentences.en: This classic story is still popular.
sentences.zh: 这个经典故事仍然很受欢迎。

sentences.en: This housing project is a classic example of how thoughtful design can improve urban life.
sentences.zh: 这个住宅项目是精心设计如何改善城市生活的典型例子。

meaning.en: a work of art, literature, or music that is of high quality and lasting value

sentences.en: She enjoys reading classics from the 19th century.
sentences.zh: 她喜欢阅读19世纪的经典作品。

meaning.zh: 古典的；传统的（尤指古希腊、古罗马文化或古典音乐等）
meaning.en: relating to ancient Greek or Roman culture, or to traditional serious music

sentences.en: She plays classical music on the piano.
sentences.zh: 她用钢琴演奏古典音乐。

sentences.en: Studying classical architecture helps students understand how ancient design principles continue to influence modern public buildings.
sentences.zh: 研究古典建筑有助于学生理解古代设计原则如何持续影响现代公共建筑。

meaning.en: the act or process of grouping things into classes or categories

sentences.en: This book explains the classification of plants.
sentences.zh: 这本书解释了植物的分类。

sentences.en: Accurate classification of species helps scientists understand biodiversity and identify ecosystems that require urgent protection.
sentences.zh: 准确的物种分类有助于科学家理解生物多样性，并识别亟须保护的生态系统。

meaning.en: to divide people or things into groups according to type or features

sentences.en: Scientists classify animals into groups.
sentences.zh: 科学家把动物分成不同的类别。

sentences.en: Researchers classify household waste into several categories to identify which materials could be recycled more effectively.
sentences.zh: 研究人员将生活垃圾分成几类，以确定哪些材料可以得到更有效的回收利用。

meaning.en: a student in the same class as you

sentences.en: A classmate shares pencils with me.
sentences.zh: 一位同学和我分享铅笔。

sentences.en: Working with classmates on group projects can help students develop communication and problem-solving skills.
sentences.zh: 与同班同学合作完成小组项目可以帮助学生培养沟通和解决问题的能力。

meaning.en: a room where students learn

sentences.en: Our classroom has a big window.
sentences.zh: 我们的教室有一扇大窗户。

sentences.en: A well-designed classroom should provide adequate lighting, comfortable furniture, and enough space for students to work together.
sentences.zh: 设计良好的教室应有充足的照明、舒适的家具，以及供学生合作学习的足够空间。

meaning.en: a loud rattling noise made by hard objects hitting each other

sentences.en: The clatter of dishes came from the kitchen.
sentences.zh: 厨房里传来盘子碰撞的哗啦声。

sentences.en: She heard the clatter of hooves on the cobblestones.
sentences.zh: 她听到马蹄在鹅卵石路面上发出的咔嗒声。

meaning.en: to make a loud rattling noise, or to move while making such a noise

sentences.en: Cups clattered in the busy kitchen.
sentences.zh: 忙碌的厨房里杯子碰得叮当响。

sentences.en: The old train clattered along the track.
sentences.zh: 那列旧火车哐当哐当地沿着铁轨行驶。

meaning.en: A separate condition or requirement in a legal document.

sentences.en: One clause in our lease allows us to keep pets.
sentences.zh: 我们的租约中有一项条款允许养宠物。

sentences.en: Employment contracts should include a clause that clearly defines workers' rights to paid leave and flexible working.
sentences.zh: 劳动合同应包含明确规定员工带薪休假和弹性工作权利的条款。

meaning.en: A group of words that contains a subject and a verb and forms part of a sentence.

sentences.en: In the sentence 'I know that he is right', 'that he is right' is a clause.
sentences.zh: 在句子“I know that he is right”中，“that he is right”是一个从句。

sentences.en: Relative clauses can make your writing more precise, but too many of them may confuse the reader.
sentences.zh: 关系从句可以使你的写作更精确，但使用过多可能会让读者困惑。

meaning.en: an extreme fear of being in small closed spaces

sentences.en: He has claustrophobia and avoids lifts.
sentences.zh: 他有幽闭恐惧症，所以避免乘电梯。

sentences.en: Her claustrophobia made the crowded subway ride almost unbearable.
sentences.zh: 她的幽闭恐惧症让拥挤的地铁之旅几乎难以忍受。

meaning.en: a sharp, curved nail on an animal's or bird's foot

sentences.en: The cat has a sharp claw.
sentences.zh: 猫有一只锋利的爪子。

sentences.en: Sharp claws help many predators catch prey, while other animals use them to climb or dig.
sentences.zh: 锋利的爪子帮助许多捕食者捕获猎物，而其他动物则用爪子攀爬或挖掘。

meaning.en: a type of heavy, sticky earth that becomes hard when baked, used for making pots, bricks, etc.

sentences.en: Children make cups from wet clay.
sentences.zh: 孩子们用湿黏土做杯子。

sentences.en: Traditional clay buildings can provide effective insulation, helping communities maintain comfortable indoor temperatures with less energy.
sentences.zh: 传统黏土建筑能有效隔热，帮助社区以更少的能源维持舒适的室内温度。

meaning.en: to make something free from dirt

sentences.en: Please clean your desk.
sentences.zh: 请打扫你的书桌。

sentences.en: Investing in clean energy can reduce air pollution while creating new employment opportunities in developing industries.
sentences.zh: 投资清洁能源可以减少空气污染，同时在新兴产业中创造就业机会。

meaning.en: a person whose job is to clean buildings or rooms

sentences.en: The cleaner empties the bins before the office opens.
sentences.zh: 清洁工在办公室开门前清空垃圾桶。

sentences.en: Hospitals should provide every cleaner with suitable protective equipment and training to reduce infection risks.
sentences.zh: 医院应为每位清洁工提供合适的防护装备和培训，以降低感染风险。

meaning.en: the state of being clean, or the habit of keeping things clean

sentences.en: Good cleanliness helps prevent disease.
sentences.zh: 良好的卫生习惯有助于预防疾病。

sentences.en: The restaurant was praised for its high standards of cleanliness.
sentences.zh: 这家餐厅因卫生标准高而受到称赞。

meaning.zh: 清洗，清洁（尤指伤口、皮肤等）
meaning.en: to make something completely clean, especially a wound or skin

sentences.en: Please cleanse the wound with clean water.
sentences.zh: 请用清水清洗伤口。

sentences.en: The nurse cleansed the cut carefully before applying a bandage.
sentences.zh: 护士在包扎前仔细清洗了伤口。

meaning.en: easy to see, with no clouds

sentences.en: The sky is clear and blue.
sentences.zh: 说明很清楚，所以我轻松地组装好了架子。

sentences.en: Public health campaigns should provide clear advice that people from different educational backgrounds can easily understand.
sentences.zh: 公共卫生宣传应提供明确的建议，让不同教育背景的人都能轻松理解。

meaning.en: The removal of unwanted objects or material from a place

sentences.en: The garden clearance took us most of Saturday.
sentences.zh: 清理花园花了我们周六大半天的时间。

sentences.en: Large-scale forest clearance can destroy wildlife habitats and increase the risk of soil erosion.
sentences.zh: 大规模森林清除会破坏野生动物栖息地，并增加水土流失的风险。

meaning.en: an open area in a forest, often created by cutting down trees

sentences.en: We stopped to rest in a small clearing in the forest.
sentences.zh: 我们在森林里的一小片空地上停下来休息。

sentences.en: The cabin stood in a clearing surrounded by tall pines.
sentences.zh: 小屋坐落在被高大松树环绕的空地上。

meaning.en: In a clear manner; in a way that is easy to see, hear, or understand.

sentences.en: Please speak clearly so everyone can hear you.
sentences.zh: 请说清楚些，让大家都能听清。

sentences.en: Public health information should clearly explain the benefits and potential risks of any recommended treatment.
sentences.zh: 公共卫生信息应清楚说明任何推荐疗法的益处和潜在风险。

meaning.en: to split something with a sharp blow

sentences.en: Farmers cleave logs for the winter fire.
sentences.zh: 农民们劈开木头用于冬天生火。

sentences.en: The axe cleaved the wood cleanly in two.
sentences.zh: 斧头将木头干净利落地劈成两半。

meaning.en: to close your hand or teeth tightly

sentences.en: He began to clench his fists.
sentences.zh: 他开始握紧双拳。

sentences.en: People under prolonged stress may clench their teeth during sleep, potentially causing pain in the jaw.
sentences.zh: 长期承受压力的人可能在睡眠中咬紧牙齿，从而引发下颌疼痛。

meaning.en: the group of people who are trained and officially allowed to lead religious services, especially in the Christian Church

sentences.en: The clergy met after the service.
sentences.zh: 礼拜结束后，神职人员聚在一起。

sentences.en: The bishop spoke to both the clergy and the congregation about the new community project.
sentences.zh: 主教就新的社区项目向神职人员和会众发表了讲话。

meaning.en: a religious official such as a priest or minister

sentences.en: The cleric led the prayer.
sentences.zh: 那位神职人员带领大家祈祷。

sentences.en: Local clerics gathered to discuss the community's response to the crisis.
sentences.zh: 当地神职人员聚集起来讨论社区如何应对这场危机。

meaning.en: relating to office work, especially keeping records and doing routine paperwork

sentences.en: She does clerical work all day.
sentences.zh: 她整天做文书工作。

sentences.en: The company is hiring a clerical assistant to handle filing and data entry.
sentences.zh: 公司正在招聘一名文书助理来处理归档和数据录入工作。

meaning.en: a person who works in an office, bank, or shop, doing administrative or sales work

sentences.en: The clerk helps us in the shop.
sentences.zh: 店员在商店里帮助我们。

sentences.en: Although digital services are expanding, many residents still prefer discussing complex applications with a trained clerk.
sentences.zh: 尽管数字服务不断扩展，许多居民仍更愿意向受过培训的办事员咨询复杂的申请事项。

meaning.en: smart and quick to understand

sentences.en: The clever fox finds the food.
sentences.zh: 那只聪明的狐狸找到了食物。

sentences.en: Clever design can make small urban apartments feel spacious without increasing their environmental impact.
sentences.zh: 巧妙的设计可以让城市小公寓显得宽敞，同时不增加其环境影响。

meaning.en: the ability to understand quickly or find effective, inventive solutions

sentences.en: Her cleverness helped us fix the tent before sunset.
sentences.zh: 她的机智让我们在日落前修好了帐篷。

sentences.en: The cleverness of a design lies in solving practical problems without introducing unnecessary complexity.
sentences.zh: 设计的巧妙之处在于解决实际问题，而不增加不必要的复杂性。

meaning.en: an expression or idea that has been used so often that it is no longer effective or interesting

sentences.en: That saying is a tired cliche.
sentences.zh: 那句话是个老掉牙的陈词滥调。

sentences.en: The speech was full of cliches about hard work and success.
sentences.zh: 那场演讲充满了关于努力和成功的陈词滥调。

meaning.en: to make a short, sharp sound

sentences.en: The lock will click when it closes.
sentences.zh: 锁关上时会发出咔嗒声。

sentences.en: Students should check whether a website is trustworthy before they click on links or share personal information.
sentences.zh: 学生在点击链接或分享个人信息前，应检查网站是否可信。

meaning.en: a person or organization that pays for goods or services from a professional or business

sentences.en: The lawyer met a new client.
sentences.zh: 律师会见了一位新客户。

sentences.en: Maintaining clear communication with each client helps businesses build trust and establish lasting professional relationships.
sentences.zh: 与每位客户保持清晰的沟通有助于企业建立信任，并形成持久的业务关系。

meaning.en: the group of customers who regularly use a shop, business, or service

sentences.en: The cafe has a loyal clientele.
sentences.zh: 这家咖啡馆有一群忠实的顾客。

sentences.en: The law firm's clientele includes several multinational corporations.
sentences.zh: 这家律师事务所的客户群包括几家跨国公司。

meaning.en: a high area of rock with a steep side

sentences.en: Birds nest on the high cliff.
sentences.zh: 鸟儿在高高的悬崖上筑巢。

sentences.en: Coastal erosion can weaken a cliff over time, putting nearby homes and walking routes at risk.
sentences.zh: 海岸侵蚀会逐渐削弱悬崖的稳定性，危及附近的住宅和步行路线。

meaning.en: Forming the most exciting or important part of something.

sentences.en: Everyone held their breath during the film's climactic scene.
sentences.zh: 电影演到高潮时，所有人都屏住了呼吸。

sentences.en: The novel's climactic confrontation reveals how social expectations can shape personal decisions and family relationships.
sentences.zh: 小说中达到高潮的冲突揭示了社会期望如何影响个人决定和家庭关系。

meaning.en: the general weather conditions in a place

sentences.en: This climate is hot and wet.
sentences.zh: 这里的气候炎热潮湿。

sentences.en: A changing climate may force farmers to grow different crops and adopt more efficient irrigation methods.
sentences.zh: 气候变化可能迫使农民改种其他作物，并采用更高效的灌溉方法。

meaning.en: long-term changes in the earth's climate, especially those caused by human activity

sentences.en: We talked about climate change at school.
sentences.zh: 我们在学校讨论了气候变化。

sentences.en: Scientists warn that climate change could lead to more extreme weather.
sentences.zh: 科学家警告说，气候变化可能导致更多极端天气。

meaning.en: The most exciting or important point of an event

sentences.en: The concert reached its climax when the whole choir joined.
sentences.zh: 整个合唱团加入演唱时，音乐会达到了高潮。

sentences.en: The film reaches its climax when the community unites to protect the forest from destruction.
sentences.zh: 当社区居民团结起来保护森林免遭破坏时，影片达到了高潮。

meaning.en: to go up using your hands and feet

sentences.en: We climb the hill on Sunday.
sentences.zh: 我们星期天爬那座小山。

sentences.en: As housing costs continue to climb, many young adults struggle to live independently in major cities.
sentences.zh: 随着住房成本持续上涨，许多年轻人难以在大城市独立生活。

meaning.en: The sport of going up rocks, mountains, or artificial walls.

sentences.en: I tried indoor climbing with my sister yesterday.
sentences.zh: 昨天我和姐姐尝试了室内攀岩。

sentences.en: Schools can use supervised climbing activities to develop students' confidence, physical coordination, and ability to assess risks.
sentences.zh: 学校可以通过有人指导的攀岩活动，培养学生的自信、身体协调性和风险评估能力。

meaning.zh: 最终确定；敲定（协议、胜利等）
meaning.en: to settle or decide something finally, especially an agreement or victory

sentences.en: One goal will clinch the win.
sentences.zh: 一个进球将锁定胜局。

sentences.en: The two companies clinched a deal after months of talks.
sentences.zh: 经过数月谈判，两家公司最终敲定了协议。

meaning.en: to hold on tightly to someone or something

sentences.en: The child will cling to her mother.
sentences.zh: 那个孩子会紧紧抱住她的母亲。

sentences.en: Some organisations cling to outdated practices even when new approaches could improve efficiency and employee satisfaction.
sentences.zh: 即使新方法能够提高效率和员工满意度，一些机构仍然固守过时的做法。

meaning.en: a place where people can get medical care

sentences.en: She waited at the clinic for her doctor.
sentences.zh: 她在诊所等她的医生。

sentences.en: Local clinics can reduce pressure on hospitals by treating common illnesses and providing preventive care.
sentences.zh: 当地诊所可以通过治疗常见病和提供预防性保健来减轻医院的压力。

meaning.en: to cut small pieces from something

sentences.en: Clip the extra paper from the edge.
sentences.zh: 把边缘多余的纸剪掉。

sentences.en: She carefully clipped the dead leaves from the plant.
sentences.zh: 她小心地把植物上的枯叶剪掉。

meaning.en: a tool for cutting hair, wire, nails, etc.

sentences.en: Dad uses clippers to cut my hair.
sentences.zh: 爸爸用理发推子给我剪头发。

sentences.en: The barber sharpened his clippers before starting the haircut.
sentences.zh: 理发师在开始理发前磨快了他的推子。

meaning.en: a long, loose coat with no sleeves

sentences.en: He wore a long dark cloak.
sentences.zh: 他穿着一件深色的长斗篷。

sentences.en: She wrapped her cloak tightly around her shoulders against the cold wind.
sentences.zh: 她把斗篷紧紧裹在肩上以抵御寒风。

meaning.en: an instrument for measuring and showing time, usually found in a room or on a wall

sentences.en: Look at the clock on the wall.
sentences.zh: 看墙上的钟。

sentences.en: Flexible working arrangements allow employees to work when they are most productive, rather than watching the clock.
sentences.zh: 弹性工作安排让员工在效率最高时工作，而不是盯着时钟等下班。

meaning.en: in the direction in which the hands of a clock move

sentences.en: Turn the lid clockwise until the jar is sealed.
sentences.zh: 顺时针拧盖子，直到罐子密封。

sentences.en: Visitors move clockwise around the exhibition hall, allowing the museum to manage crowds and prevent congestion.
sentences.zh: 参观者沿顺时针方向绕展厅行进，便于博物馆管理人流并防止拥堵。

meaning.en: to block a pipe or path

sentences.en: Hair can clog the bathroom drain.
sentences.zh: 头发会堵塞浴室排水管。

sentences.en: Fallen leaves clogged the storm drains after the heavy rain.
sentences.zh: 大雨过后，落叶堵塞了雨水排水沟。

meaning.zh: 克隆；无性繁殖（产生与生物体基因完全相同的副本）
meaning.en: to produce an identical copy of a living thing

sentences.en: Scientists can clone some plants in a lab.
sentences.zh: 科学家可以在实验室里克隆一些植物。

sentences.en: Researchers are trying to clone endangered animals to help save the species.
sentences.zh: 研究人员正试图克隆濒危动物，以帮助拯救这些物种。

meaning.en: near in space or time; not far away

sentences.en: The shop is close to our house.
sentences.zh: 那家商店离我们家很近。

sentences.en: The two countries have maintained close ties for decades.
sentences.zh: 这两个国家几十年来一直保持着密切的关系。

meaning.en: to shut something, or to become shut

sentences.en: Please close the window before the rain comes in.
sentences.zh: 请在雨飘进来之前关上窗户。

sentences.en: When local libraries close, residents lose valuable spaces for independent learning and community activities.
sentences.zh: 当本地图书馆关闭时，居民就失去了自主学习和开展社区活动的宝贵场所。

meaning.en: near to; almost

sentences.en: We talked about close to at school.

meaning.en: not open; shut

sentences.en: The shop is closed on Sunday.
sentences.zh: 开着暖气时，请把窗户关好。

sentences.en: When local libraries remain closed at weekends, working families have fewer opportunities to access educational resources.
sentences.zh: 如果当地图书馆周末不开放，上班族家庭获取教育资源的机会就会减少。

meaning.en: with careful attention to details or changes; in a close manner

sentences.en: Look closely at this leaf and notice its tiny veins.
sentences.zh: 仔细看看这片叶子，留意它细小的叶脉。

sentences.en: Governments should closely monitor air quality near schools to protect children from the harmful effects of pollution.
sentences.zh: 政府应密切监测学校附近的空气质量，保护儿童免受污染的危害。

meaning.en: a small room or cupboard for storing clothes or things

sentences.en: Hang your coat in the closet.
sentences.zh: 把你的外套挂在壁橱里。

sentences.en: Small apartments can feel more spacious when residents organise belongings efficiently and make better use of closet space.
sentences.zh: 如果住户高效整理物品，更充分地利用壁橱空间，小公寓也会显得更宽敞。

meaning.en: the act of closing something, especially permanently

sentences.en: The shop faces closure next month.
sentences.zh: 这家商店下个月面临停业。

sentences.en: The factory closure left hundreds of workers unemployed.
sentences.zh: 工厂关闭导致数百名工人失业。

meaning.en: woven or felted fabric made from cotton, wool, or other fibers, used for making clothes, etc.

sentences.en: She cuts the cloth for a shirt.
sentences.zh: 她剪布做衬衫。

sentences.en: Replacing disposable wipes with reusable cloth can reduce household waste and lower long-term cleaning costs.
sentences.zh: 用可重复使用的布代替一次性湿巾，可以减少家庭垃圾并降低长期清洁成本。

meaning.en: To dress someone or provide them with clothes

sentences.en: The charity helps feed and clothe families during winter.
sentences.zh: 这家慈善机构在冬季帮助家庭解决吃穿问题。

sentences.en: Low wages can make it difficult for parents to feed and clothe their children adequately.
sentences.zh: 低工资可能使父母难以让孩子吃饱穿暖。

meaning.en: things you wear, such as shirts and pants

sentences.en: I put my clothes in the closet.
sentences.zh: 我把衣服放进衣柜里。

sentences.en: Buying durable clothes rather than frequently replacing cheap garments can reduce household waste and save resources.
sentences.zh: 购买耐穿的衣服，而不是频繁更换廉价服装，可以减少家庭垃圾并节约资源。

meaning.zh: 服装，衣着（尤指某种类型的衣服）
meaning.en: clothes, especially of a particular type

sentences.en: Pack some warm clothing for our camping trip this weekend.
sentences.zh: 为我们周末的露营之旅带些保暖衣物。

sentences.en: The clothing industry can reduce its environmental impact by using recycled materials and designing products that last longer.
sentences.zh: 服装行业可以通过使用再生材料和设计更耐穿的产品来减少对环境的影响。

meaning.en: a white or grey mass in the sky, made of small drops of water

sentences.en: A white cloud floats in the sky.
sentences.zh: 一朵白云在天空中飘浮。

sentences.en: Dark clouds gathered before the storm.
sentences.zh: 暴风雨来临前，乌云密布。

meaning.en: with many clouds; not sunny

sentences.en: It was cloudy, so we left our sunglasses at home.
sentences.zh: 当时天阴着，所以我们把太阳镜留在了家里。

sentences.en: Solar panels can still generate electricity on cloudy days, although their output is usually lower.
sentences.zh: 太阳能电池板在阴天仍能发电，不过发电量通常较低。

meaning.zh: 影响力，势力（尤指政治或社会方面）
meaning.en: power or influence over people or events, especially in politics or society

sentences.en: The union has political clout.
sentences.zh: 这家工会有政治影响力。

sentences.en: Small countries often lack the economic clout to shape global trade rules.
sentences.zh: 小国往往缺乏影响全球贸易规则的经济实力。

meaning.en: a small plant of the genus Trifolium, typically with three round leaves and dense heads of small flowers

sentences.en: A clover is growing in the grass.
sentences.zh: 草地上长着一株三叶草。

sentences.en: Farmers often plant clover to improve the soil.
sentences.zh: 农民常种植三叶草来改良土壤。

meaning.en: an entertainer who wears funny clothes and does silly things

sentences.en: The clown made the children laugh.
sentences.zh: 小丑让孩子们笑了起来。

sentences.en: A trained clown can help young patients feel more comfortable during their stay in hospital.
sentences.zh: 受过训练的小丑演员能帮助住院儿童放松心情。

meaning.en: a small tropical fish with bright orange and white stripes, often living among sea anemones

sentences.en: A clownfish hides in the coral.
sentences.zh: 一条小丑鱼躲在珊瑚里。

sentences.en: Clownfish are famous for living safely among the stinging tentacles of sea anemones.
sentences.zh: 小丑鱼以能在海葵带刺的触手间安全生活而闻名。

meaning.en: a group of people who meet regularly to share an activity or interest

sentences.en: He joins the chess club.
sentences.zh: 他加入了国际象棋俱乐部。

sentences.en: A school sports club can help students develop teamwork skills while encouraging regular physical activity.
sentences.zh: 学校体育社团可以帮助学生培养团队合作能力，同时鼓励他们经常锻炼。

meaning.en: a building where club members meet and use shared facilities

sentences.en: We left our tennis bags outside the clubhouse.
sentences.zh: 我们把网球包放在了俱乐部会所外面。

sentences.en: A shared clubhouse can strengthen community ties by giving local sports teams a place to meet regularly.
sentences.zh: 共用会所为当地运动队提供定期聚会的场所，有助于加强社区联系。

meaning.en: a piece of information that helps solve a problem or mystery

sentences.en: This clue helps us find the toy.
sentences.zh: 这条线索帮助我们找到玩具。

sentences.en: Ancient tools provide valuable clues about how early communities adapted to changes in their natural environment.
sentences.zh: 古代工具为研究早期群落如何适应自然环境的变化提供了宝贵线索。

meaning.zh: 一丛，一簇（紧密生长在一起的植物等）
meaning.en: a group of things, especially plants, growing or standing close together

sentences.en: A clump of trees hid the house.
sentences.zh: 一丛树遮住了那座房子。

sentences.en: She knelt beside a clump of wild flowers and began to sketch them.
sentences.zh: 她跪在一簇野花旁，开始给它们画速写。

meaning.en: not careful or graceful in movement

sentences.en: The clumsy boy dropped the cup.
sentences.zh: 那个笨手笨脚的男孩把杯子掉在了地上。

sentences.en: A clumsy attempt to explain new regulations can reduce public confidence in local government.
sentences.zh: 对新规定的解释若处理不当，可能会削弱公众对地方政府的信任。

meaning.en: a group of similar things or people positioned or occurring closely together

sentences.en: A cluster of grapes hung from the vine.
sentences.zh: 藤上挂着一串葡萄。

sentences.en: Technology companies often cluster near universities, where they can recruit skilled graduates and collaborate with researchers.
sentences.zh: 科技公司往往聚集在大学附近，便于招聘技能娴熟的毕业生并与研究人员合作。

meaning.en: to hold something tightly

sentences.en: She clutched the child's hand as they crossed the road.
sentences.zh: 过马路时她紧紧抓住孩子的手。

sentences.en: He clutched the letter to his chest and refused to let go.
sentences.zh: 他把信紧紧贴在胸前，不肯松手。

meaning.en: a device in a vehicle that connects and disconnects the engine; a tight hold

sentences.en: Press the clutch before you change gears.
sentences.zh: 换挡前先踩下离合器。

sentences.en: The driver released the clutch too quickly and the car stalled.
sentences.zh: 司机松离合器太快，车熄火了。

meaning.en: a lot of things in an untidy state; mess

sentences.en: Please clear the clutter.
sentences.zh: 请清理这些杂物。

sentences.en: The kitchen table was covered with clutter, so we had to tidy it before dinner.
sentences.zh: 厨房桌子上堆满了杂物，所以我们不得不在晚饭前收拾干净。

meaning.en: centimetre; a unit of length equal to one hundredth of a metre

sentences.en: The pencil is about 15 cm long.
sentences.zh: 这支铅笔大约15厘米长。

sentences.en: Please measure the width of the table in cm.
sentences.zh: 请用厘米测量桌子的宽度。

meaning.en: a person who trains a sports team or player

sentences.en: The coach teaches us to pass.
sentences.zh: 教练教我们传球。

sentences.en: A skilled coach can help young athletes build confidence while developing healthy attitudes towards competition.
sentences.zh: 优秀的教练能帮助年轻运动员建立信心，同时培养他们对竞争的健康态度。

meaning.en: a black mineral used to produce heat

sentences.en: They burn coal to heat the house.
sentences.zh: 他们烧煤给房子取暖。

sentences.en: Replacing coal with renewable energy can reduce air pollution and lower greenhouse gas emissions from electricity generation.
sentences.zh: 用可再生能源替代煤炭，可以减少空气污染并降低发电产生的温室气体排放。

meaning.zh: （政党、团体等为共同目的组成的）联盟，联合体
meaning.en: a temporary alliance of political parties or groups formed for a shared purpose

sentences.en: The parties formed a coalition to win the election.
sentences.zh: 各党派结成联盟以赢得选举。

sentences.en: The coalition government struggled to agree on economic policy.
sentences.zh: 联合政府难以就经济政策达成一致。

meaning.en: rough in texture; rude or offensive in manner

sentences.en: This cloth feels coarse.
sentences.zh: 这块布摸起来很粗糙。

sentences.en: Coarse particles in urban air can irritate the lungs and worsen existing respiratory conditions among vulnerable residents.
sentences.zh: 城市空气中的粗颗粒物会刺激肺部，并加重易感居民原有的呼吸系统疾病。

meaning.en: the land along the sea

sentences.en: We walk along the sea coast.
sentences.zh: 我们沿着海岸散步。

sentences.en: Communities along the coast face increasing risks from rising sea levels and severe storms.
sentences.zh: 沿海社区面临着海平面上升和强风暴带来的日益严重的风险。

meaning.en: relating to or located on the coast

sentences.en: We stayed in a small coastal town during the holiday.
sentences.zh: 假期里我们住在一个沿海小镇。

sentences.en: Coastal areas are often at risk from rising sea levels.
sentences.zh: 沿海地区常常面临海平面上升的风险。

meaning.en: a small mat put under a glass or cup

sentences.en: Put the cup on the coaster.
sentences.zh: 把杯子放在杯垫上。

sentences.en: She bought a set of cork coasters to protect the wooden table.
sentences.zh: 她买了一套软木杯垫来保护木桌。

meaning.en: a warm piece of clothing you wear outside

sentences.en: I put on my coat in winter.
sentences.zh: 冬天我穿上外套。

sentences.en: Applying a protective coat to metal structures can reduce maintenance costs and extend their useful life.
sentences.zh: 给金属结构涂上保护层可以降低维护成本，延长其使用寿命。

meaning.en: to persuade someone gently or gradually

sentences.en: She tried to coax the cat out of the tree.
sentences.zh: 她试着把猫从树上哄下来。

sentences.en: He coaxed his little brother into finishing his homework.
sentences.zh: 他哄着弟弟把作业做完。

meaning.zh: 鹅卵石（常用于复数 cobbles，指鹅卵石路面）
meaning.en: a small round stone, often used in plural to mean a street paved with such stones

sentences.en: The old street is paved with cobbles.
sentences.zh: 这条老街是用鹅卵石铺成的。

sentences.en: She tripped on the uneven cobbles in the narrow alley.
sentences.zh: 她在狭窄小巷里不平的鹅卵石路面上绊了一下。

meaning.zh: 粗制滥造；匆忙拼凑（常与 together 连用）
meaning.en: to make or put something together quickly and roughly, often with together

sentences.en: They cobbled together a simple shelter for the night.
sentences.zh: 他们匆忙拼凑了一个简易的过夜棚子。

sentences.en: The report was cobbled together from old data and guesswork.
sentences.zh: 这份报告是用旧数据和猜测匆忙拼凑而成的。

meaning.en: a poisonous snake that can spread the skin around its neck into a hood

sentences.en: The cobra lifts its wide hood.
sentences.zh: 眼镜蛇抬起了它宽大的颈部皮褶。

sentences.en: Visitors were warned to stay away from the cobra's nest.
sentences.zh: 游客被警告要远离眼镜蛇的巢穴。

meaning.en: a net of threads made by a spider

sentences.en: A cobweb hung in the corner.
sentences.zh: 角落里挂着一张蜘蛛网。

sentences.en: She brushed the cobwebs from the old furniture.
sentences.zh: 她拂去旧家具上的蜘蛛网。

meaning.en: A powerful, addictive stimulant drug derived from coca leaves.

sentences.en: The nurse explained why cocaine can seriously harm the heart.
sentences.zh: 护士解释了可卡因为何会严重损害心脏。

sentences.en: Public health programmes should combine education about cocaine with accessible treatment for people experiencing addiction.
sentences.zh: 公共卫生项目应将可卡因危害教育与便捷可及的成瘾治疗相结合。

meaning.en: An adult male chicken.

sentences.en: A red cock crowed loudly beside the wooden door.
sentences.zh: 一只红色公鸡在木门旁大声啼叫。

sentences.en: Keeping a cock alongside hens allows small farms to breed chickens without purchasing new birds.
sentences.zh: 小型农场把公鸡和母鸡一起饲养，就能自行繁育鸡，而不必购买新鸡。

meaning.en: a large brown insect with long antennae that lives in warm, dark places

sentences.en: A cockroach ran across the kitchen floor.
sentences.zh: 一只蟑螂从厨房地板上跑过。

sentences.en: Cockroaches can survive for weeks without food, which makes them hard to get rid of.
sentences.zh: 蟑螂没有食物也能存活数周，因此很难彻底清除。

meaning.en: a mixed alcoholic drink, often made with spirits, juice, and other flavorings

sentences.en: She ordered a cocktail at the bar.
sentences.zh: 她在酒吧点了一杯鸡尾酒。

sentences.en: The bartender mixed a refreshing cocktail with gin and lime juice.
sentences.zh: 调酒师用杜松子酒和青柠汁调制了一杯清爽的鸡尾酒。

meaning.en: a brown powder made from cocoa beans, used to make chocolate and drinks

sentences.en: Add two spoons of cocoa to the milk.
sentences.zh: 往牛奶里加两勺可可粉。

sentences.en: The recipe calls for unsweetened cocoa and a little sugar.
sentences.zh: 这个食谱需要无糖可可粉和少量糖。

meaning.en: A large tropical fruit with a hard shell and white flesh.

sentences.en: We shared a fresh coconut on the beach.
sentences.zh: 我们在海滩边分着吃了一个新鲜椰子。

sentences.en: Coastal farmers can earn additional income by processing coconut shells into useful household products.
sentences.zh: 沿海农民可以通过将椰壳加工成实用的家居用品来增加收入。

meaning.en: a sea fish often cooked for meals

sentences.en: We eat cod with potatoes.
sentences.zh: 我们吃鳕鱼配土豆。

sentences.en: Strict fishing limits can help cod populations recover while protecting the long-term livelihoods of coastal communities.
sentences.zh: 严格的捕捞限额可以帮助鳕鱼种群恢复，同时保障沿海社区的长远生计。

meaning.en: a system of words, letters, or signs used to represent information secretly or in a particular way

sentences.en: The door needs a secret code.
sentences.zh: 这扇门需要密码。

sentences.en: Teaching students to write code can strengthen problem-solving skills and prepare them for a changing job market.
sentences.zh: 教学生编写代码可以增强解决问题的能力，帮助他们适应不断变化的就业市场。

meaning.en: The education of boys and girls together in the same institution.

sentences.en: My grandparents first experienced coeducation at their village school.
sentences.zh: 我的祖父母在村里的学校首次接受了男女同校教育。

sentences.en: Supporters of coeducation argue that learning together helps boys and girls develop mutual respect.
sentences.zh: 支持男女同校教育的人认为，共同学习有助于男孩和女孩培养相互尊重的态度。

meaning.en: A number that multiplies a variable in a mathematical expression, or a measure of a property.

sentences.en: Our teacher explained how the coefficient changes the curve.
sentences.zh: 老师解释了系数如何改变曲线的形状。

sentences.en: A high correlation coefficient indicates a strong statistical relationship, but it does not necessarily establish causation.
sentences.zh: 较高的相关系数表明存在较强的统计关联，但不一定能证明因果关系。

meaning.en: to force someone to do something by using threats or pressure

sentences.en: Do not coerce him into signing the contract.
sentences.zh: 不要强迫他签合同。

sentences.en: The company was accused of coercing employees into working overtime without pay.
sentences.zh: 该公司被指控胁迫员工无薪加班。

meaning.en: to exist or live together at the same time, especially peacefully

sentences.en: The two groups coexist in peace.
sentences.zh: 这两个群体和平共处。

sentences.en: Modern cities must find ways for economic growth and environmental protection to coexist.
sentences.zh: 现代城市必须找到让经济增长与环境保护共存的方法。

meaning.en: a hot brown drink made from roasted coffee beans

sentences.en: Dad drinks coffee in the morning.
sentences.zh: 爸爸早上喝咖啡。

sentences.en: Rising temperatures may threaten coffee production, affecting the incomes of farmers in several developing countries.
sentences.zh: 气温上升可能威胁咖啡生产，影响一些发展中国家农民的收入。

meaning.zh: 保险箱；金库；（尤指公共或机构的）资金，财源
meaning.en: a strong box or chest for keeping money and valuables; (also) funds or financial reserves, especially of an organization

sentences.en: Gold lay in the wooden coffer.
sentences.zh: 金子存放在那个木制保险箱里。

sentences.en: The charity's coffers were depleted after years of mismanagement.
sentences.zh: 由于多年管理不善，这家慈善机构的资金被耗尽了。

meaning.en: a box used for burying dead people

sentences.en: They placed flowers on the coffin.
sentences.zh: 他们把花放在棺材上。

sentences.en: The materials used to make a coffin can reflect local resources and cultural traditions.
sentences.zh: 制作棺材所用的材料可以反映当地资源和文化传统。

meaning.en: A tooth on a gear, or the gear itself

sentences.en: A broken cog stopped the old clock from working.
sentences.zh: 一个断裂的轮齿让那座老钟停止了运转。

sentences.en: Employees may lose motivation if they feel like a cog in a machine rather than valued contributors.
sentences.zh: 如果员工觉得自己只是机器中的小零件，而非受到重视的贡献者，就可能失去动力。

meaning.en: the mental process of knowing, understanding, and thinking

sentences.en: Sleep helps human cognition.
sentences.zh: 睡眠有助于人类的认知。

sentences.en: The study examines how bilingual experience influences cognition in older adults.
sentences.zh: 这项研究考察双语经验如何影响老年人的认知。

meaning.en: Related to mental processes such as learning, remembering, and understanding.

sentences.en: These puzzles help my grandmother keep her cognitive skills sharp.
sentences.zh: 这些益智游戏帮助我祖母保持敏锐的认知能力。

sentences.en: Regular physical activity may support cognitive development in children and help older adults maintain their memory.
sentences.zh: 规律的身体活动可能促进儿童认知发展，并帮助老年人保持记忆力。

meaning.en: aware of or knowing about something

sentences.en: I am cognizant of the risk.
sentences.zh: 我知晓其中的风险。

sentences.en: Employees should be cognizant of the company's data protection policies.
sentences.zh: 员工应当了解公司的数据保护政策。

meaning.en: the quality of being clear, logical, and connected

sentences.en: The essay lacks coherence.
sentences.zh: 这篇文章缺乏连贯性。

sentences.en: Clear paragraph structure improves the coherence of an essay and helps readers follow complex arguments.
sentences.zh: 清晰的段落结构能增强文章的连贯性，帮助读者理解复杂的论证。

meaning.en: logical and consistent; easy to understand because ideas are well connected

sentences.en: Please give a coherent answer to the question.
sentences.zh: 请对这个问题给出一个条理清楚的回答。

sentences.en: A coherent transport policy should connect investment in public services with long-term environmental and economic goals.
sentences.zh: 一项协调一致的交通政策应将公共服务投资与长期环境和经济目标联系起来。

meaning.en: the quality of being united as a group

sentences.en: Our weekly team lunches helped build cohesion at work.
sentences.zh: 我们每周的团队午餐有助于增强工作中的凝聚力。

sentences.en: Shared public spaces can strengthen social cohesion by encouraging regular interaction between residents from different backgrounds.
sentences.zh: 共享公共空间能促进不同背景的居民经常交流，从而增强社会凝聚力。

meaning.zh: 有凝聚力的；紧密结合的
meaning.en: united or closely connected as a whole

sentences.en: Regular practice helped us become a more cohesive team.
sentences.zh: 定期练习帮助我们成为一支更有凝聚力的队伍。

sentences.en: Shared public spaces can help build cohesive communities by encouraging interaction among people from different backgrounds.
sentences.zh: 共享公共空间可以促进不同背景的人交流，从而帮助建设有凝聚力的社区。

meaning.zh: （有共同特征的）一群人；（尤指）同期群体
meaning.en: a group of people who share a particular characteristic, especially one born or working at the same time

sentences.en: His cohort of friends stayed loyal.
sentences.zh: 他那群朋友一直很忠诚。

sentences.en: The study followed a cohort of 500 students over four years.
sentences.zh: 这项研究在四年间追踪了一个由500名学生组成的同期群体。

meaning.en: to wind into a series of loops

sentences.en: Snakes coil around the thick branch.
sentences.zh: 蛇盘绕在粗树枝上。

sentences.en: Engineers coil long pipes beneath buildings so that heat can be transferred efficiently from the ground.
sentences.zh: 工程师在建筑物下方盘绕长管道，以便高效地传递地下热量。

meaning.en: a small round piece of metal money

sentences.en: I found a coin on the floor.
sentences.zh: 我在地板上发现了一枚硬币。

sentences.en: As digital payments become more widespread, fewer consumers carry coins for everyday purchases such as bus fares.
sentences.zh: 随着数字支付日益普及，随身携带硬币用于公交车费等日常支出的人越来越少。

meaning.en: a newly invented word, or the creation of new words

sentences.en: Her playful coinage quickly became popular among her friends.
sentences.zh: 她随口创造的俏皮新词很快在朋友中流行起来。

sentences.en: The rapid growth of digital technology encourages the coinage of terms for previously unfamiliar experiences.
sentences.zh: 数字技术的快速发展促使人们创造新词，描述以往陌生的体验。

meaning.en: to happen at the same time

sentences.en: The two events coincide on the same day.
sentences.zh: 这两个事件在同一天发生。

sentences.en: Government investment should coincide with local priorities to ensure that public funds address genuine community needs.
sentences.zh: 政府投资应与地方优先事项相一致，以确保公共资金满足社区的真实需求。

meaning.en: a situation in which two or more things happen at the same time by chance, without being planned or connected

sentences.en: We use the word coincidence in class.
sentences.zh: 真巧，我们俩午餐时都穿了绿色夹克。

sentences.en: Researchers must distinguish between coincidence and genuine causal relationships when interpreting changes in public health data.
sentences.zh: 研究人员解读公共卫生数据的变化时，必须区分巧合与真正的因果关系。

meaning.en: a sweet brown carbonated drink, especially Coca-Cola

sentences.en: I drink Coke with lunch.
sentences.zh: 我午餐时喝可乐。

sentences.en: Could you get me a can of coke from the fridge?
sentences.zh: 你能从冰箱里给我拿一罐可乐吗？

meaning.en: a sweet brown fizzy drink

sentences.en: He poured cold cola into a glass with ice.
sentences.zh: 他把冰可乐倒进一个放了冰块的玻璃杯。

sentences.en: Reducing the consumption of sugary drinks such as cola may help prevent tooth decay in children.
sentences.zh: 减少可乐等含糖饮料的摄入，可能有助于预防儿童龋齿。

meaning.en: having a low temperature, not warm

sentences.en: The water in winter is cold.
sentences.zh: 冬天的水很冷。

sentences.en: Cold weather can increase household energy costs, placing additional pressure on families with limited incomes.
sentences.zh: 寒冷天气会增加家庭能源开支，给收入有限的家庭带来额外压力。

meaning.en: the quality or state of being cold; low temperature

sentences.en: The coldness of the water made me gasp.
sentences.zh: 冰冷的水让我倒吸了一口气。

sentences.en: The coldness of the winter air kept most people indoors.
sentences.zh: 冬天空气的寒冷让大多数人待在室内。

meaning.en: a lack of friendliness or warmth in manner or feeling

sentences.en: There was a coldness in her voice that surprised me.
sentences.zh: 她声音里的冷淡让我感到惊讶。

sentences.en: The apparent coldness of online communication can make it harder for remote workers to build trusting relationships.
sentences.zh: 网络交流表面上的冷淡可能让远程工作者更难建立信任关系。

meaning.en: to work together with someone or an organization to achieve something

sentences.en: Two classes collaborate on the science project.
sentences.zh: 两个班级合作完成这个科学项目。

sentences.en: Universities should collaborate with local businesses to develop practical solutions to regional environmental problems.
sentences.zh: 大学应与当地企业合作，为区域环境问题制定切实可行的解决方案。

meaning.en: the act of working together with others to achieve a shared goal

sentences.en: Our garden makeover was a collaboration between several neighbours.
sentences.zh: 我们花园的改造是几位邻居合作完成的。

sentences.en: Closer collaboration between universities and local businesses can help students develop practical skills before entering the workforce.
sentences.zh: 大学与当地企业更紧密的合作可以帮助学生在就业前培养实用技能。

meaning.en: involving two or more people or groups working together to achieve something

sentences.en: The project was a collaborative effort between students and teachers.
sentences.zh: 这个项目是师生合作的成果。

sentences.en: Collaborative learning encourages students to share ideas and solve problems together.
sentences.zh: 协作学习鼓励学生分享想法并共同解决问题。

meaning.en: to fall down suddenly

sentences.en: The old roof may collapse in a storm.
sentences.zh: 旧屋顶在暴风雨中可能会倒塌。

sentences.en: Poor maintenance can cause bridges to collapse, making regular inspections essential for public safety.
sentences.zh: 维护不善可能导致桥梁坍塌，因此定期检查对公共安全至关重要。

meaning.en: a band or part that goes around the neck, as on a shirt or an animal's neck

sentences.en: The cat has a bell on its collar.
sentences.zh: 那只猫的颈圈上挂着一个铃铛。

sentences.en: A well-fitted collar allows owners to attach a lead and keep dogs under control in public spaces.
sentences.zh: 合适的颈圈方便主人系上牵引绳，在公共场所管好狗。

meaning.en: a person you work with, especially in a profession or business

sentences.en: My colleague helped me finish the report.
sentences.zh: 我的同事帮我完成了这份报告。

sentences.en: Sharing knowledge with colleagues can improve workplace efficiency and help new employees develop essential skills.
sentences.zh: 与同事分享知识可以提高工作效率，并帮助新员工培养必要技能。

meaning.en: to bring things of the same kind together

sentences.en: I collect pretty stamps at home.
sentences.zh: 我在家里收集漂亮的邮票。

sentences.en: Researchers collect data from local households to assess how transport policies affect daily travel habits.
sentences.zh: 研究人员收集当地家庭的数据，以评估交通政策如何影响日常出行习惯。

meaning.en: a group of things that are collected or gathered together

sentences.en: He has a collection of old stamps.
sentences.zh: 他有一批旧邮票收藏。

sentences.en: Regular household waste collection is essential for protecting public health and maintaining a clean urban environment.
sentences.zh: 定期收运生活垃圾对于保护公众健康和保持城市环境整洁至关重要。
