sentences.zh: 我们忙了好几个周末才建好花园。

sentences.en: Investment in renewable energy can support job creation while helping countries reduce their dependence on fossil fuels.
sentences.zh: 投资可再生能源可以促进就业，同时帮助各国减少对化石燃料的依赖。

meaning.en: able to produce new and original ideas

sentences.en: The creative boy makes a paper bird.
sentences.zh: 这个有创造力的男孩做了一只纸鸟。

sentences.en: Schools should encourage creative thinking by allowing students to explore several solutions to the same problem.
sentences.zh: 学校应允许学生探索同一问题的多种解决方案，以鼓励创造性思维。

meaning.en: the ability to produce original and unusual ideas, or to make something new or imaginative

sentences.en: Teachers should encourage creativity in the classroom.
sentences.zh: 教师应该在课堂上鼓励创造力。

sentences.en: The success of the project depended on the team's creativity and willingness to experiment.
sentences.zh: 项目的成功取决于团队的创造力以及尝试的意愿。

meaning.en: a living animal or being

sentences.en: A small creature hides in the grass.
sentences.zh: 一只小生物藏在草丛里。

sentences.en: Even the smallest marine creature can play an important role in maintaining a healthy ocean ecosystem.
sentences.zh: 即使是最小的海洋生物，也能在维持健康的海洋生态系统方面发挥重要作用。

meaning.en: documents or qualifications that prove a person's identity, abilities, or right to do something

sentences.en: Please show your credentials.
sentences.zh: 请出示你的证件。

sentences.en: The job requires strong academic credentials and relevant work experience.
sentences.zh: 这份工作需要过硬的学历背景和相关工作经验。

meaning.en: able to be believed or trusted

sentences.en: We need a credible witness.
sentences.zh: 我们需要一个可信的证人。

sentences.en: The report lacks credible evidence, so its conclusions are hard to accept.
sentences.zh: 这份报告缺乏可信的证据，因此其结论难以令人接受。

meaning.en: the ability to buy something now and pay for it later

sentences.en: She buys the sofa on credit.
sentences.zh: 她赊账买了这张沙发。

sentences.en: Affordable credit can help small businesses invest in equipment and create jobs within local communities.
sentences.zh: 成本可负担的信贷能帮助小企业投资设备，并为当地社区创造就业机会。

meaning.en: a small plastic card issued by a bank, allowing the holder to buy goods or services on credit

sentences.en: I paid for the meal with my credit card.
sentences.zh: 我用信用卡支付了这顿饭。

sentences.en: If you don't pay off your credit card balance each month, interest will be charged.
sentences.zh: 如果你不每月还清信用卡欠款，就会被收取利息。

meaning.en: a set of beliefs or principles, especially religious or guiding one's life

sentences.en: Honesty is part of their creed.
sentences.zh: 诚实是他们信条的一部分。

sentences.en: People of different creeds should be able to live together in peace.
sentences.zh: 不同信仰的人应该能够和平共处。

meaning.en: a small stream or river; (BrE) a narrow inlet of the sea

sentences.en: We fished in a shallow creek.
sentences.zh: 我们在一条浅浅的小溪里钓鱼。

sentences.en: The path follows the creek through the woods to the sea.
sentences.zh: 这条小路沿着小溪穿过树林，一直通向大海。

meaning.zh: 蹑手蹑脚地走；缓慢移动
meaning.en: to move slowly and quietly, often to avoid being noticed

sentences.en: I crept upstairs to avoid waking the sleeping baby.
sentences.zh: 我蹑手蹑脚地上楼，以免吵醒熟睡的宝宝。

sentences.en: Housing costs can creep up gradually, placing increasing financial pressure on families with limited incomes.
sentences.zh: 住房成本可能逐渐上涨，给收入有限的家庭带来越来越大的经济压力。

meaning.en: a plant that grows along the ground or up walls and trees, often with long stems

sentences.en: A green creeper grew up the brick wall.
sentences.zh: 一株绿色的攀缘植物沿着砖墙向上生长。

sentences.en: The old house was covered with ivy and other creepers.
sentences.zh: 那座老房子上爬满了常春藤和其他攀缘植物。

meaning.en: a curved shape that is wide in the middle and pointed at both ends, especially the shape of the moon when it is partly lit

sentences.en: A crescent moon hung in the sky.
sentences.zh: 一弯新月挂在天空中。

sentences.en: The bakery sells croissants in the shape of a crescent.
sentences.zh: 这家面包店出售新月形的羊角面包。

meaning.en: shaped like a crescent

sentences.en: The crescent moon was clearly visible.
sentences.zh: 新月清晰可见。

meaning.en: the highest point of a hill or wave

sentences.en: Snow covers the crest of the mountain.
sentences.zh: 积雪覆盖着山顶。

sentences.en: The surfer balanced on the crest of a huge wave.
sentences.zh: 冲浪者在巨浪的浪尖上保持平衡。

meaning.zh: 全体船员（或机组人员、工作人员）
meaning.en: a group of people who work together, especially on a ship or aircraft

sentences.en: The ship crew works all night.
sentences.zh: 全体船员整夜工作。

sentences.en: Airlines must ensure that every crew member receives regular safety training to protect passengers during emergencies.
sentences.zh: 航空公司必须确保每位机组成员定期接受安全培训，以便在紧急情况下保护乘客。

meaning.en: a small insect that makes a chirping sound

sentences.en: The cricket sings at night.
sentences.zh: 蟋蟀在夜里鸣叫。

sentences.en: Crickets are often heard on warm summer evenings.
sentences.zh: 在温暖的夏夜，常常能听到蟋蟀的叫声。

meaning.en: a game played by two teams with a bat and ball

sentences.en: We played cricket in the park after lunch.
sentences.zh: 午饭后，我们在公园里打板球。

sentences.en: Team sports such as cricket can help young people develop cooperation skills and build lasting friendships.
sentences.zh: 板球等团队运动可以帮助年轻人培养合作能力，建立持久的友谊。

meaning.en: an illegal activity or action

sentences.en: Stealing is a crime in this town.
sentences.zh: 在这个镇上，偷窃是一种犯罪。

sentences.en: Investment in education and employment opportunities may reduce crime more effectively than increasingly severe punishments.
sentences.zh: 投资教育和增加就业机会，可能比不断加重惩罚更有效地减少犯罪。

meaning.en: a person who commits a crime

sentences.en: The criminal hides in an old house.
sentences.zh: 那名罪犯躲在一栋旧房子里。

sentences.en: Education and employment programmes may reduce criminal behaviour by providing young people with better opportunities.
sentences.zh: 教育和就业项目可以为年轻人提供更好的机会，从而可能减少犯罪行为。

meaning.en: relating to crime or its punishment

sentences.en: Education and employment programmes may reduce criminal behaviour by providing young people with better opportunities.
sentences.zh: 教育和就业项目可以为年轻人提供更好的机会，从而可能减少犯罪行为。

meaning.en: the scientific study of crime and criminals

sentences.en: She is studying criminology at university.
sentences.zh: 她在大学学习犯罪学。

sentences.en: Criminology helps us understand the causes of crime and how to prevent it.
sentences.zh: 犯罪学有助于我们理解犯罪的原因以及如何预防犯罪。

meaning.en: a deep red color

sentences.en: The sky turned crimson at sunset.
sentences.zh: 日落时天空变成了深红色。

sentences.en: The artist used crimson to make the flowers stand out against the dark background.
sentences.zh: 画家用绯红色让花朵在深色背景中格外醒目。

meaning.zh: 畏缩；退缩（因恐惧或厌恶）
meaning.en: to move back or shrink away in fear or disgust

sentences.en: The dog will cringe at a loud shout.
sentences.zh: 狗听到大声喊叫会畏缩。

sentences.en: She cringed when she saw the embarrassing photo of herself.
sentences.zh: 她看到自己那张尴尬的照片时畏缩了。

meaning.zh: 使严重受损；使瘫痪；使残废
meaning.en: to damage someone or something severely, making them unable to function normally

sentences.en: The storm may cripple the town.
sentences.zh: 这场风暴可能会使小镇陷入瘫痪。

sentences.en: A prolonged drought can cripple agricultural production, reducing rural incomes and increasing food prices across the country.
sentences.zh: 长期干旱可能重创农业生产，降低农村收入，并推高全国食品价格。

meaning.en: a time of great danger, difficulty, or confusion

sentences.en: The city faced a water crisis last summer.
sentences.zh: 去年夏天，这座城市面临水危机。

sentences.en: The housing crisis has forced many young adults to delay moving into their own homes.
sentences.zh: 住房危机迫使许多年轻人推迟搬进自己的住所。

meaning.en: pleasantly hard and dry, and making a sharp sound when bitten or crushed

sentences.en: The potatoes were crisp and golden brown.
sentences.zh: 土豆片酥脆金黄。

sentences.en: Packaging helps keep snacks crisp, but excessive use of plastic creates significant environmental problems.
sentences.zh: 包装有助于保持零食酥脆，但过度使用塑料会造成严重的环境问题。

meaning.en: Standards used to judge something or make a decision.

sentences.en: This flat meets all our criteria for a home.
sentences.zh: 这套公寓符合我们对住房的所有要求。

sentences.en: Scholarships should be awarded according to clear criteria that consider both academic achievement and financial need.
sentences.zh: 奖学金应依据明确的标准颁发，同时考虑学业成绩和经济需求。

meaning.en: a standard or principle used for judging or deciding something

sentences.en: Price was the main criterion for our choice.
sentences.zh: 价格是我们做选择的主要标准。

sentences.en: Environmental impact should be a key criterion when governments assess proposals for new transport infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 政府评估新交通基础设施提案时，应将环境影响作为重要标准。

meaning.en: a person who expresses opinions about the good and bad qualities of something, especially art, music, films, or books; or a person who disapproves of something

sentences.en: The critic writes about the new film.
sentences.zh: 那位评论家为这部新电影写评论。

sentences.en: Critics of urban expansion argue that new developments often destroy valuable habitats and increase car dependence.
sentences.zh: 城市扩张的批评者认为，新开发项目往往破坏宝贵的栖息地，并增加人们对汽车的依赖。

meaning.en: extremely important to the success or outcome of something

sentences.en: Your support was critical when I started my business.
sentences.zh: 我创业时，你的支持至关重要。

sentences.en: Access to clean water is critical to improving public health in rapidly growing urban communities.
sentences.zh: 获得清洁用水对改善快速发展城市社区的公共卫生至关重要。

meaning.en: the act of expressing disapproval of someone or something, or remarks that point out faults

sentences.en: Her criticism of the plan was fair and clear.
sentences.zh: 她对这项计划的批评公正而明确。

sentences.en: The new policy has drawn criticism from both teachers and parents.
sentences.zh: 这项新政策受到了教师和家长的批评。

meaning.en: to give a negative opinion of something or someone

sentences.en: Do not criticize him in front of others.
sentences.zh: 不要当着别人的面批评他。

sentences.en: Many residents criticize the council for prioritizing road construction over improvements to public transport.
sentences.zh: 许多居民批评地方议会优先修建道路，而非改善公共交通。

meaning.en: a careful judgment or analysis of something, especially a written or spoken one

sentences.en: She wrote a critique of the film.
sentences.zh: 她写了一篇关于这部电影的评论。

sentences.en: The professor offered a detailed critique of the research paper.
sentences.zh: 教授对这篇研究论文进行了详细的评论。

meaning.en: to make clothes or fabric using a hooked needle and yarn

sentences.en: Grandma likes to crochet warm scarves.
sentences.zh: 奶奶喜欢钩织温暖的围巾。

sentences.en: She spent the afternoon crocheting a delicate lace pattern for the tablecloth.
sentences.zh: 她花了一下午时间为桌布钩织精美的蕾丝图案。

meaning.en: a large reptile with a long body, powerful tail, and long jaws with many teeth

sentences.en: The crocodile opens its long mouth.
sentences.zh: 鳄鱼张开了它长长的嘴。

sentences.en: Wetland conservation protects crocodile habitats while also supporting the fish and birds that depend on these ecosystems.
sentences.zh: 湿地保护既能保护鳄鱼的栖息地，也有利于依赖这些生态系统的鱼类和鸟类。

meaning.zh: 亲信；密友（常含贬义，指有权者身边的亲密朋友）
meaning.en: a close friend of someone powerful, often used disapprovingly

sentences.en: The mayor hired an old crony.
sentences.zh: 市长雇用了一位老亲信。

sentences.en: Critics say the minister filled key posts with political cronies.
sentences.zh: 批评者说这位部长把关键职位都安排给了政治亲信。

meaning.en: a person who cheats or steals; a criminal

sentences.en: The crook stole money from the old shop.
sentences.zh: 那个骗子偷了老店的钱。

sentences.en: Police finally caught the crook who had been cheating tourists for years.
sentences.zh: 警方终于抓住了那个多年来一直欺骗游客的骗子。

meaning.en: a bend or curve, especially in a river or a person's arm

sentences.en: She carried the basket in the crook of her arm.
sentences.zh: 她把篮子挎在臂弯里。

sentences.en: The river makes a sharp crook just before it reaches the sea.
sentences.zh: 那条河在入海前形成了一个急弯。

meaning.en: not straight; bent or twisted

sentences.en: The old tree had a crooked trunk.
sentences.zh: 那棵老树的树干是弯曲的。

sentences.en: He drew a crooked line across the page.
sentences.zh: 他在页面上画了一条歪歪扭扭的线。

meaning.en: a plant grown for food

sentences.en: Farmers grow a rice crop here.
sentences.zh: 农民在这里种植水稻。

sentences.en: Rising temperatures may reduce crop yields, threatening food security in regions that already experience water shortages.
sentences.zh: 气温上升可能导致农作物减产，威胁本就缺水地区的粮食安全。

meaning.en: land used for growing crops

sentences.en: The cropland stretches for miles along the river.
sentences.zh: 农田沿着河流延伸数英里。

sentences.en: Converting forest into cropland can lead to soil erosion.
sentences.zh: 将森林转变为耕地可能导致水土流失。

meaning.en: to go from one side of something to the other

sentences.en: We cross the road with Mum.
sentences.zh: 我们和妈妈一起过马路。

sentences.en: Safer pedestrian routes encourage residents to cross busy roads on foot rather than drive short distances.
sentences.zh: 更安全的步行路线鼓励居民步行穿过繁忙道路，而不是短途开车。

meaning.en: to draw a line through written words to show they are wrong or no longer wanted

sentences.en: Cross out the wrong answer.
sentences.zh: 把错误答案划掉。

sentences.en: The teacher asked us to cross out any spelling mistakes in the paragraph.
sentences.zh: 老师让我们把段落中的拼写错误划掉。

meaning.en: A place where pedestrians can cross a road safely, or a place where two roads meet and cross.

sentences.en: We waited at the pedestrian crossing until the cars stopped.
sentences.zh: 我们在人行横道前等到车辆停下才过马路。

sentences.en: Installing a pedestrian crossing near every school can help protect children and encourage more families to walk.
sentences.zh: 在每所学校附近设置人行横道，有助于保护儿童并鼓励更多家庭步行。

meaning.en: A place where two or more roads meet and cross.

sentences.en: Turn left at the crossroads.
sentences.zh: 在十字路口向左转。

sentences.en: The old hotel stands at a busy crossroads in the city center.
sentences.zh: 那家老旅馆位于市中心一个繁忙的十字路口。

meaning.en: a word game in a pattern of black and white squares

sentences.en: Grandpa finished the crossword after breakfast.
sentences.zh: 爷爷早饭后完成了纵横字谜。

sentences.en: She does the crossword in the newspaper every morning to keep her mind sharp.
sentences.zh: 她每天早上做报纸上的纵横字谜，以保持头脑敏锐。

meaning.en: to bend your knees and lower your body close to the ground

sentences.en: The cat will crouch before it jumps.
sentences.zh: 猫在跳之前会蹲伏下来。

sentences.en: She crouched down to pick up the coin from the floor.
sentences.zh: 她蹲下去捡地板上的硬币。

meaning.en: a large black bird with a loud harsh cry

sentences.en: A black crow is sitting on the fence beside our garden.
sentences.zh: 一只乌鸦落在我们花园旁的围栏上。

sentences.en: Studies of crow behaviour suggest that some birds can solve complex problems and use simple tools.
sentences.zh: 对乌鸦行为的研究表明，有些鸟类能够解决复杂问题并使用简单工具。

meaning.en: a large group of people gathered together

sentences.en: A crowd watches the school play.
sentences.zh: 一群人观看学校话剧。

sentences.en: Large crowds at popular attractions can damage historic sites unless visitor numbers are carefully managed.
sentences.zh: 热门景点的大量游客可能破坏历史遗址，除非游客数量得到妥善管理。

meaning.en: full of people or things, so that there is little space

sentences.en: Students study the word crowded in this book.
sentences.zh: 公交车太拥挤了，我们一路都站着。

sentences.en: Crowded urban neighbourhoods need accessible parks where residents can exercise and enjoy some personal space.
sentences.zh: 拥挤的城市社区需要方便到达的公园，让居民能够锻炼并享有一些个人空间。

meaning.en: a circular ornament worn on the head by a king or queen as a symbol of royal power

sentences.en: The queen wore a gold crown.
sentences.zh: 女王戴着一顶金色王冠。

sentences.en: A royal crown displayed in a museum can reveal historical attitudes towards wealth, authority, and craftsmanship.
sentences.zh: 博物馆里展出的王冠可以揭示历史上人们对财富、权威和工艺的态度。

meaning.en: to make someone king or queen in a formal ceremony

sentences.en: The archbishop crowned the new king in the cathedral.
sentences.zh: 大主教在大教堂为新国王加冕。

sentences.en: She was crowned queen after a long and bitter succession dispute.
sentences.zh: 经过漫长而激烈的继承权争端后，她被加冕为女王。

meaning.en: extremely important, especially for the success of something

sentences.en: Sleep is crucial for a healthy body.
sentences.zh: 睡眠对身体健康至关重要。

sentences.en: Access to reliable public transport is crucial for people seeking employment beyond their immediate neighbourhoods.
sentences.zh: 对于想在居住地附近以外寻找工作的人来说，可靠的公共交通至关重要。

meaning.en: in a natural or unrefined state

sentences.en: The factory turns crude oil into petrol.
sentences.zh: 这家工厂把原油提炼成汽油。

sentences.en: Crude estimates suggest that the project will cost millions.
sentences.zh: 粗略估计，这个项目将耗资数百万。

meaning.en: causing pain or suffering to others; unkind

sentences.en: Students study the word cruel in this book.
sentences.zh: 嘲笑她的错误很刻薄。

sentences.en: Schools should address cruel behaviour early to ensure that every child feels safe and respected.
sentences.zh: 学校应及早处理伤害他人的行为，确保每个孩子都感到安全并受到尊重。

meaning.en: behavior that causes pain or suffering to others

sentences.en: Cruelty to animals is wrong.
sentences.zh: 虐待动物是错误的。

sentences.en: The novel exposes the cruelty of war through the eyes of a child.
sentences.zh: 这部小说通过一个孩子的视角揭露了战争的残酷。

meaning.en: a holiday on a ship

sentences.en: They took a cruise last summer.
sentences.zh: 去年夏天他们乘船度假了。

sentences.en: The growing popularity of cruise holidays has raised concerns about air pollution in coastal cities.
sentences.zh: 邮轮度假日益流行，引发了人们对沿海城市空气污染的担忧。

meaning.en: A powered boat designed for leisure cruising, often with cabin space.

sentences.en: We spent the weekend aboard a small cabin cruiser.
sentences.zh: 我们在一艘小型舱式游艇上度过了周末。

sentences.en: The growing popularity of holidays aboard a cruiser has increased demand for moorings along inland waterways.
sentences.zh: 乘坐游艇度假日益流行，使内陆水道沿线的泊位需求有所增加。

meaning.en: a small particle or bit of bread, cake, etc.

sentences.en: A bread crumb fell onto the clean table.
sentences.zh: 一粒面包屑掉到了干净的桌子上。

sentences.en: Even small food scraps, such as bread crumbs, can attract pests when waste is poorly managed.
sentences.zh: 如果垃圾处理不当，即使是面包屑这样的小块食物残渣，也会招来害虫。

meaning.en: to break into small pieces; to fall apart or collapse

sentences.en: Old walls crumble after many years of rain.
sentences.zh: 多年的雨水冲刷后，旧墙会碎裂。

sentences.en: Without regular maintenance, historic buildings may crumble, causing communities to lose an important part of their heritage.
sentences.zh: 如果没有定期维护，历史建筑可能逐渐坍塌，使社区失去重要的文化遗产。

meaning.en: to crush something so that it has folds or wrinkles

sentences.en: Do not crumple the clean paper.
sentences.zh: 不要把干净的纸弄皱。

sentences.en: She crumpled the letter in her hand and threw it away.
sentences.zh: 她把信在手里揉皱后扔掉了。

meaning.zh: 松脆的；脆的（咬时发出清脆声响）
meaning.en: hard and making a sharp noise when bitten or crushed

sentences.en: The apple was fresh, sweet, and crunchy.
sentences.zh: 这个苹果新鲜、香甜，而且松脆。

sentences.en: She sprinkled crunchy nuts over the yogurt for extra texture.
sentences.zh: 她在酸奶上撒了松脆的坚果，以增加口感。

meaning.en: a determined campaign for change

sentences.en: They launched a crusade against litter.
sentences.zh: 他们发起了一场反对乱扔垃圾的运动。

sentences.en: Her crusade for equal pay attracted widespread support.
sentences.zh: 她为同工同酬发起的运动赢得了广泛支持。

meaning.en: a medieval Christian military expedition to the Holy Land

sentences.en: The First Crusade began in 1096.
sentences.zh: 第一次十字军东征始于1096年。

meaning.zh: 发起运动；从事改革运动
meaning.en: to campaign determinedly for change

sentences.en: She crusaded for years to improve working conditions.
sentences.zh: 她多年来为改善工作条件而奔走呼号。

meaning.en: to press something so that its shape is destroyed

sentences.en: Do not crush the eggs in the bag.
sentences.zh: 不要压碎袋子里的鸡蛋。

sentences.en: The machine crushes the rocks into small pieces.
sentences.zh: 这台机器把岩石压碎成小块。

meaning.en: the hard outer surface of bread

sentences.en: The bread crust was brown and hard.
sentences.zh: 面包皮呈棕色，很硬。

sentences.en: Movements within the Earth's crust can cause earthquakes that severely damage buildings and transport networks.
sentences.zh: 地壳内部的运动可能引发地震，严重破坏建筑物和交通网络。

meaning.en: the outer layer of the Earth

sentences.en: Movements within the Earth's crust can cause earthquakes that severely damage buildings and transport networks.
sentences.zh: 地壳内部的运动可能引发地震，严重破坏建筑物和交通网络。

meaning.en: to produce tears from your eyes, usually because you are sad, hurt, or upset

sentences.en: Babies cry when they are hungry.
sentences.zh: 婴儿饿了就会哭。

sentences.en: Young children may cry when separated from their parents, so schools should provide a welcoming environment.
sentences.zh: 幼儿与父母分开时可能会哭，因此学校应营造亲切友好的环境。

meaning.en: the act or sound of shedding tears from emotion or pain

sentences.en: Soft crying came from the baby's room after midnight.
sentences.zh: 午夜过后，婴儿房里传来轻轻的哭声。

sentences.en: The crying of the child could be heard through the thin walls.
sentences.zh: 透过薄薄的墙壁，可以听到那个孩子的哭声。

meaning.en: very great and urgent; needing immediate attention

sentences.en: There is a crying need for affordable childcare in communities where both parents work full time.
sentences.zh: 在父母双方都全职工作的社区，迫切需要价格可负担的托育服务。

meaning.en: having a meaning that is mysterious or not easily understood

sentences.en: She left a cryptic note.
sentences.zh: 她留下了一张隐晦的便条。

sentences.en: His cryptic remarks left everyone guessing what he really meant.
sentences.zh: 他隐晦的言论让每个人都猜不透他真正的意思。

meaning.en: a clear, transparent mineral, or a solid substance with a regular internal structure

sentences.en: The crystal shone in the light.
sentences.zh: 水晶在光线下闪闪发光。

sentences.en: The structure of a crystal influences its physical properties and determines its suitability for various industrial applications.
sentences.zh: 晶体结构影响其物理性质，并决定它是否适合各种工业用途。

meaning.en: to form or cause to form crystals

sentences.en: Salt crystallizes when the water evaporates.
sentences.zh: 水蒸发时盐会结晶。

sentences.en: The scientist crystallized the compound to purify it.
sentences.zh: 科学家使该化合物结晶以进行提纯。

meaning.zh: 幼兽（如熊、狮、狐等的幼崽）
meaning.en: a young wild animal, especially a bear, lion, or fox

sentences.en: The lion cub stayed near its mother.
sentences.zh: 小狮子待在妈妈身边。

sentences.en: The bear cubs were playing in the snow while their mother watched.
sentences.zh: 小熊们在雪地里玩耍，它们的妈妈在一旁看着。

meaning.en: a solid shape with six equal square faces

sentences.en: Cut the cheese into a small cube.
sentences.zh: 把奶酪切成一个小立方体。

sentences.en: The ice cubes clinked in the glass.
sentences.zh: 冰块在玻璃杯里叮当作响。

meaning.en: shaped like a cube, or relating to volume measured in cubes

sentences.en: Our new water tank can hold two cubic metres of water.
sentences.zh: 我们的新水箱能容纳两立方米的水。

sentences.en: Modern irrigation systems can save thousands of cubic metres of water each year.
sentences.zh: 现代灌溉系统每年可以节约数千立方米的水。

meaning.en: An art style showing subjects through geometric shapes and multiple viewpoints.

sentences.en: We explored cubism by painting faces with overlapping geometric shapes.
sentences.zh: 我们用重叠的几何图形画人脸，探索立体主义风格。

sentences.en: Cubism challenged traditional artistic representation by presenting multiple viewpoints within a single image rather than imitating natural appearances.
sentences.zh: 立体主义在同一幅图像中呈现多个视角，而非模仿自然外观，从而挑战了传统艺术表现方式。

meaning.en: a bird that lays its eggs in other birds' nests and has a distinctive call

sentences.en: We heard a cuckoo calling from the woods.
sentences.zh: 我们听到树林里有一只杜鹃在叫。

sentences.en: The cuckoo is known for laying its eggs in the nests of other birds.
sentences.zh: 杜鹃以在其他鸟类的巢中产卵而闻名。

meaning.en: A long vegetable with green skin and crisp, watery flesh.

sentences.en: She sliced a cucumber and added it to the salad.
sentences.zh: 她把一根黄瓜切成片，加入沙拉。

sentences.en: Growing cucumbers in greenhouses can provide a reliable food supply, but heating these structures requires energy.
sentences.zh: 在温室中种植黄瓜可以提供稳定的食物供应，但为这些设施供暖需要消耗能源。

meaning.en: to hold someone close in a loving or affectionate way

sentences.en: The mother will cuddle the baby.
sentences.zh: 母亲会搂抱婴儿。

sentences.en: The couple cuddled on the sofa while watching a movie.
sentences.zh: 这对情侣看电影时依偎在沙发上。

meaning.en: a signal or hint that tells someone what to do or what is happening

sentences.en: The teacher gave us a cue to start the discussion.
sentences.zh: 老师给了我们一个开始讨论的提示。

sentences.en: When the music started, it was our cue to walk onto the stage.
sentences.zh: 音乐响起时，那就是我们上台的提示。

meaning.en: the end part of a sleeve, or a folded band at the bottom of a trouser leg

sentences.en: He spilled tea on his cuff.
sentences.zh: 他把茶洒在了袖口上。

sentences.en: She rolled up her cuffs before washing the dishes.
sentences.zh: 洗碗前她把袖口卷了起来。

meaning.en: a style of cooking, especially of a particular country or region

sentences.en: I love French cuisine.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢法国菜。

sentences.en: Traditional cuisine can attract international tourists while helping local communities preserve their cultural identity.
sentences.zh: 传统菜系既能吸引国际游客，也能帮助当地社区保留文化特色。

meaning.zh: 达到顶点；最终导致（常与in连用）
meaning.en: to reach the highest point or final result; to end in a particular way (often followed by in)

sentences.en: The talks culminate in a peace deal.
sentences.zh: 会谈最终达成了一项和平协议。

sentences.en: Years of public consultation culminated in a comprehensive transport plan designed to reduce congestion and improve accessibility.
sentences.zh: 多年的公众咨询最终促成了一项旨在缓解拥堵、改善交通可达性的综合交通规划。

meaning.zh: 罪犯；肇事者；问题的根源
meaning.en: a person responsible for a crime or problem; the cause of a problem

sentences.en: Police found the real culprit.
sentences.zh: 警方找到了真正的罪犯。

sentences.en: Poor communication is often the culprit behind team failures.
sentences.zh: 沟通不畅往往是团队失败的根源。

meaning.en: a small religious or social group with extreme beliefs and practices, often considered dangerous or strange

sentences.en: The film is about a strange cult.
sentences.zh: 这部电影讲述了一个奇怪的邪教。

sentences.en: She was warned not to join the cult, which controlled its members' lives.
sentences.zh: 她被警告不要加入那个控制成员生活的邪教。

meaning.en: to prepare and use land for growing crops, or to grow plants

sentences.en: Farmers cultivate rice in the wet fields.
sentences.zh: 我的祖父母在屋后的小菜园里种菜。

sentences.en: Schools should cultivate curiosity by encouraging students to ask questions and explore different solutions to practical problems.
sentences.zh: 学校应鼓励学生提问并探索实际问题的不同解决方法，以培养好奇心。

meaning.en: to develop a quality, skill, or relationship over time
relating to the ideas, customs, and social behavior of a society, or to art, music, and literature

sentences.en: We visit a cultural show in town.
sentences.zh: 我们参观了镇上的文化演出。

sentences.en: Schools can promote cultural understanding by encouraging students to share their family traditions and experiences.
sentences.zh: 学校可以鼓励学生分享家庭传统和经历，从而促进文化理解。

meaning.en: the way of life, customs, and beliefs of a group of people

sentences.en: Sharing traditional meals helps children learn about their own culture.
sentences.zh: 分享传统餐食有助于孩子了解自己的文化。

sentences.en: Preserving local culture can strengthen community identity while allowing residents to benefit from international exchange.
sentences.zh: 保护本土文化可以增强社区认同，同时让居民受益于国际交流。

meaning.zh: 笨重的；难以移动或使用的
meaning.en: large, heavy, or awkward and therefore hard to move or use

sentences.en: The box is too cumbersome to carry upstairs.
sentences.zh: 这个箱子太笨重了，搬不上楼。

sentences.en: Early computers were cumbersome machines that filled entire rooms.
sentences.zh: 早期的计算机是占满整个房间的笨重机器。

meaning.en: complicated and inefficient, often causing unnecessary difficulty

sentences.en: The application process is cumbersome and takes several weeks.
sentences.zh: 申请流程繁琐，要花好几周时间。

meaning.en: increasing gradually as more of something is added

sentences.en: The damage is cumulative.
sentences.zh: 损害是累积性的。

sentences.en: The cumulative effect of years of stress can seriously harm your health.
sentences.zh: 多年压力的累积效应会严重损害你的健康。

meaning.en: clever at tricking people

sentences.en: The cunning thief escaped through a window.
sentences.zh: 那个狡猾的小偷从窗户逃走了。

sentences.en: Cunning advertising tactics can persuade consumers to purchase products they neither need nor can afford.
sentences.zh: 狡猾的广告手段可能诱使消费者购买既不需要也负担不起的产品。

meaning.en: the quality of being clever at tricking people

sentences.en: She used cunning to get what she wanted.
sentences.zh: 她靠狡诈得到了想要的东西。

sentences.en: His political cunning helped him survive many scandals.
sentences.zh: 他的政治手腕帮助他挺过了许多丑闻。

meaning.en: A small container for drinking, or the amount it holds.

sentences.en: I warmed my hands around a cup of tea.
sentences.zh: 我双手捧着一杯茶取暖。

sentences.en: Encouraging customers to bring a reusable cup can help cafés reduce waste from disposable packaging.
sentences.zh: 鼓励顾客自带可重复使用的杯子，可以帮助咖啡馆减少一次性包装垃圾。

meaning.en: a small container with a handle, used for drinking; the amount it holds

sentences.en: She poured tea into a cup.
sentences.zh: 她把茶倒进杯子里。

sentences.en: He drank a cup of coffee before the meeting.
sentences.zh: 开会前他喝了一杯咖啡。

meaning.en: a piece of furniture with doors and shelves, used for storing food, dishes, or other items

sentences.en: Cups are in the kitchen cupboard.
sentences.zh: 杯子在厨房的橱柜里。

sentences.en: Well-designed cupboards can maximise storage space in small apartments without making living areas feel crowded.
sentences.zh: 设计合理的橱柜可以充分利用小公寓的储物空间，又不会让起居区域显得拥挤。

meaning.zh: 馆长；（博物馆、美术馆等的）策展人
meaning.en: a person who is in charge of a museum, gallery, or collection, or who organizes exhibitions

sentences.en: The curator showed us the art.
sentences.zh: 馆长带我们参观了艺术品。

sentences.en: As a curator, she is responsible for selecting and arranging the exhibits for the new exhibition.
sentences.zh: 作为策展人，她负责为新展览挑选和布置展品。

meaning.en: to restrain or keep something under control

sentences.en: New laws curb the sale of cheap cigarettes.
sentences.zh: 新法律抑制了廉价香烟的销售。

sentences.en: Cities can curb air pollution by improving public transport and encouraging residents to cycle.
sentences.zh: 城市可以通过改善公共交通和鼓励居民骑车来抑制空气污染。

meaning.zh: 治愈，治好（疾病）；解决（问题）
meaning.en: to make an illness or a problem go away

sentences.en: Rest can cure a light cold.
sentences.zh: 医生说这些药片可以治好这种感染。

sentences.en: Although medical research has advanced considerably, scientists have not yet found a cure for every disease.
sentences.zh: 尽管医学研究已取得显著进展，科学家仍未找到治愈所有疾病的方法。

meaning.en: a rule that people must stay inside after a particular time, especially at night

sentences.en: The city set a night curfew.
sentences.zh: 该市实行了夜间宵禁。

sentences.en: During the emergency, the government imposed a curfew from 10 p.m. to 6 a.m.
sentences.zh: 紧急状态期间，政府实施了晚上10点到早上6点的宵禁。

meaning.en: a strong desire to learn or know about something

sentences.en: Curiosity led me to open the dusty wooden box.
sentences.zh: 好奇心驱使我打开了那个积满灰尘的木盒。

sentences.en: Schools should encourage children's curiosity by allowing them to investigate questions through practical experiments.
sentences.zh: 学校应让孩子通过动手实验探究问题，从而激发他们的求知欲。

meaning.en: wanting to know more about things

sentences.en: The curious cat opens the box.
sentences.zh: 那只好奇的猫打开了盒子。

sentences.en: Teachers can encourage curious students to explore scientific questions through practical experiments rather than memorisation alone.
sentences.zh: 教师可以鼓励求知欲强的学生通过动手实验探索科学问题，而不只是死记硬背。

meaning.zh: 好奇地；奇怪地，令人费解地
meaning.en: in a way that shows interest and a desire to know; in a strange or surprising way

sentences.en: She looked curiously at the old map.
sentences.zh: 她好奇地看着那张旧地图。

sentences.en: Curiously, the door was unlocked when we returned.
sentences.zh: 奇怪的是，我们回来时门没有锁。

meaning.en: to form or make something form a curved shape

sentences.en: The dry leaves curl at the edges in autumn.
sentences.zh: 秋天，干枯的叶子边缘会卷起来。

sentences.en: During prolonged droughts, leaves may curl to reduce water loss and protect plants from further damage.
sentences.zh: 在持续干旱期间，叶片可能卷曲，以减少水分流失并保护植物免受进一步损害。

meaning.en: forming curves and circles

sentences.en: She has curly brown hair.
sentences.zh: 她有一头棕色卷发。

sentences.en: Advertising should represent people with diverse appearances, including those with curly hair and different skin tones.
sentences.zh: 广告应展现外貌各异的人，包括卷发者和不同肤色的人。

meaning.en: the system of money that a country uses

sentences.en: The currency of Japan is the yen.
sentences.zh: 日本的货币是日元。

sentences.en: A weaker currency can attract international tourists by making accommodation and other services more affordable.
sentences.zh: 货币贬值可以降低住宿和其他服务的价格，从而吸引国际游客。

meaning.en: of the present time

sentences.en: The current news is on the radio.
sentences.zh: 当前的新闻正在收音机上播出。

sentences.en: Current policies may need revision as cities face increasing pressure on housing and transport.
sentences.zh: 随着城市住房和交通压力不断增加，现行政策可能需要调整。

meaning.en: at the present time

sentences.en: Our kitchen is currently full of boxes from the move.
sentences.zh: 我们的厨房目前堆满了搬家用的箱子。

sentences.en: Many cities are currently investing in cycling infrastructure to reduce traffic congestion and improve urban air quality.
sentences.zh: 许多城市目前正在投资建设自行车基础设施，以缓解交通拥堵并改善城市空气质量。

meaning.en: the subjects that are taught by a school, college, etc., or the things that are studied in a particular subject

sentences.en: Science is part of the school curriculum.
sentences.zh: 科学是学校课程的一部分。

sentences.en: A balanced curriculum should develop practical skills alongside academic knowledge to prepare students for adult life.
sentences.zh: 均衡的课程体系应在传授学术知识的同时培养实用技能，为学生的成年生活做准备。

meaning.zh: 咖喱（一种用香料烹制的菜肴，常源自南亚）
meaning.en: a dish made with a mixture of spices, originally from South Asia

sentences.en: We ate chicken curry with rice.
sentences.zh: 我们吃了鸡肉咖喱配米饭。

sentences.en: School cafeterias can offer vegetable curry as an affordable alternative to meals containing meat.
sentences.zh: 学校食堂可以提供蔬菜咖喱，作为价格实惠的非肉类餐食选择。

meaning.en: to use offensive language; to swear

sentences.en: Do not curse in this classroom.
sentences.zh: 不要在这个教室里骂人。

sentences.en: For isolated communities, unreliable transport can be a curse that limits access to healthcare and employment.
sentences.zh: 对偏远社区而言，不可靠的交通可能成为祸害，限制居民获得医疗服务和就业机会。

meaning.en: using very few words in a rude or unfriendly way

sentences.en: His curt reply hurt her feelings.
sentences.zh: 他简慢的回答伤了她的感情。

sentences.en: Curt responses from public service staff may discourage residents from seeking information about essential community support.
sentences.zh: 公共服务人员生硬的回应可能使居民不愿咨询必要的社区援助信息。

meaning.en: to reduce, limit, or shorten something

sentences.en: The school had to curtail art classes.
sentences.zh: 学校不得不削减美术课。

sentences.en: The government decided to curtail public spending in order to reduce the deficit.
sentences.zh: 政府决定削减公共开支以减少赤字。

meaning.en: a piece of cloth that is hung to cover a window

sentences.en: Please close the curtain at night.
sentences.zh: 晚上请拉上窗帘。

sentences.en: Installing a thick curtain over each window can reduce heat loss and improve comfort in older homes.
sentences.zh: 在每扇窗户上安装厚窗帘，可以减少热量流失，提升老房屋的居住舒适度。

meaning.en: pieces of cloth hung at a window to block light or for privacy

sentences.en: Please close the curtains at night.
sentences.zh: 晚上请拉上窗帘。

sentences.en: She drew the curtains to let in the morning light.
sentences.zh: 她拉开窗帘，让晨光照进来。

meaning.en: a line or shape that bends smoothly; a bend in a road

sentences.en: The driver slowed down as we approached a sharp curve.
sentences.zh: 我们接近一个急弯时，司机放慢了车速。

sentences.en: Roads that curve around existing woodland can reduce habitat destruction, although they may increase construction costs.
sentences.zh: 绕着现有林地修建的弯曲道路可以减少栖息地破坏，但可能增加建设成本。

meaning.en: to bend or move in a smooth, curved line

sentences.en: The road curves to the left after the bridge.
sentences.zh: 过了桥之后，道路向左弯曲。

sentences.en: The graph curves upward sharply after the first year.
sentences.zh: 第一年之后，图表曲线急剧上升。

meaning.en: having a shape that bends continuously; not straight

sentences.en: The road is curved around the hill.
sentences.zh: 一条弯曲的小路从我们的大门通向池塘。

sentences.en: Curved building designs can create distinctive urban landmarks, although they may require more complex construction techniques.
sentences.zh: 弧形建筑设计能打造独特的城市地标，但可能需要更复杂的施工技术。

meaning.en: a soft object filled with material, used for sitting or leaning on

sentences.en: She sat on a soft cushion by the window.
sentences.zh: 她坐在窗边一个柔软的坐垫上。

sentences.en: The old chair had a worn cushion that needed replacing.
sentences.zh: 那把旧椅子的坐垫已经磨损，需要更换了。

meaning.en: to reduce the force or effect of something

sentences.en: Emergency savings can cushion the financial impact of unemployment.
sentences.zh: 应急储蓄可以缓冲失业带来的经济冲击。

meaning.zh: 蛋奶羹（一种甜点，常与水果或糕点同食）
meaning.en: a sweet yellow sauce made from milk, eggs, and sugar, often served with fruit or pastry

sentences.en: She poured custard on the apple pie.
sentences.zh: 她把蛋奶羹倒在苹果派上。

sentences.en: The chef prepared a vanilla custard to accompany the fresh berries.
sentences.zh: 厨师做了一份香草蛋奶羹来搭配新鲜浆果。

meaning.en: A person or organization responsible for protecting or managing something.

sentences.en: The custodian carefully locked the cabinet containing ancient coins.
sentences.zh: 保管人小心地锁好了存放古钱币的柜子。

sentences.en: Museums act as custodians of cultural heritage, preserving valuable objects for research and future generations.
sentences.zh: 博物馆充当文化遗产的守护者，为研究和后代保存珍贵物品。

meaning.en: the legal right or duty to care for a child or property; the state of being kept in prison

sentences.en: The child is in her custody.
sentences.zh: 孩子由她监护。

sentences.en: The suspect was taken into police custody after the incident.
sentences.zh: 事件发生后，嫌疑人被警方拘留。

meaning.en: a traditional and widely accepted way of behaving or doing something in a particular society or group

sentences.en: This custom is old in our town.
sentences.zh: 这个习俗在我们镇上由来已久。

sentences.en: Schools can introduce children to local customs while encouraging respect for traditions from other cultures.
sentences.zh: 学校可以向孩子们介绍当地风俗，同时鼓励他们尊重其他文化的传统。

meaning.en: usual or traditional for a particular person or group

sentences.en: It is customary to give gifts at weddings in many cultures.
sentences.zh: 在许多文化中，婚礼上送礼是习俗。

sentences.en: In some countries, it is customary for guests to remove their shoes before entering a home.
sentences.zh: 在一些国家，客人进屋前脱鞋是惯常做法。

meaning.en: a person who buys goods or services

sentences.en: The customer pays for the apples.
sentences.zh: 这位顾客为苹果付钱。

sentences.en: Businesses can build customer loyalty by providing reliable products and responding quickly to complaints.
sentences.zh: 企业可以通过提供可靠的产品并迅速回应投诉来培养客户忠诚度。

meaning.en: The government authority or place that checks goods and people entering a country

sentences.en: We opened our suitcases for inspection at customs.
sentences.zh: 我们在海关打开行李箱接受检查。

sentences.en: More efficient customs procedures can reduce delays at borders and support international trade without weakening security.
sentences.zh: 更高效的海关程序可以减少边境延误，在不削弱安全保障的情况下促进国际贸易。

meaning.en: to divide or make an opening in something using a knife, scissors, or similar tool

sentences.en: Please cut the paper in half.
sentences.zh: 请把这张纸切成两半。

sentences.en: Local councils can cut energy costs by installing efficient lighting in public buildings.
sentences.zh: 地方议会可以通过在公共建筑内安装节能照明设备来削减能源开支。

meaning.en: to cut something into small pieces

sentences.en: She cut up the vegetables for the soup.
sentences.zh: 她把蔬菜切碎用来做汤。

sentences.en: The children cut up old magazines to make a collage.
sentences.zh: 孩子们把旧杂志剪碎来做拼贴画。

meaning.zh: 削减；裁减（尤指经费或人员）
meaning.en: a reduction in something, especially money or staff

sentences.en: The school faced a budget cutback.
sentences.zh: 学校面临预算削减。

sentences.en: The company announced cutbacks in spending to cope with the economic downturn.
sentences.zh: 公司宣布削减开支以应对经济下滑。

meaning.en: pretty and attractive in a charming way

sentences.en: The cute puppy sleeps in a box.
sentences.zh: 那只可爱的小狗睡在盒子里。

sentences.en: Advertisements often feature cute animals to attract attention and create positive feelings towards a product.
sentences.zh: 广告常用可爱的动物吸引注意，让人们对产品产生好感。

meaning.en: Knives, forks, and spoons used for eating or serving food.

sentences.en: Please put the clean cutlery beside the plates.
sentences.zh: 请把干净的刀叉匙放在盘子旁边。

sentences.en: Restaurants can reduce plastic waste by replacing disposable cutlery with durable alternatives that can be washed and reused.
sentences.zh: 餐馆可以用可清洗、可重复使用的耐用餐具替代一次性餐具，以减少塑料垃圾。

meaning.en: A tool or machine used to cut materials.

sentences.en: Use this pastry cutter to make round biscuits.
sentences.zh: 用这个面点切模做圆形饼干。

sentences.en: A modern laser cutter can reduce material waste and improve precision in furniture production.
sentences.zh: 现代激光切割机可以减少材料浪费，提高家具生产的精度。

meaning.en: Intended to hurt someone through harsh criticism or unkind remarks.

sentences.en: His cutting remark about her cooking spoiled the meal.
sentences.zh: 他对她厨艺的尖刻评价破坏了用餐的气氛。

sentences.en: Cutting comments from teachers can discourage students from asking questions and participating actively in class.
sentences.zh: 教师尖刻的评论可能使学生不敢提问，也不愿积极参与课堂活动。

meaning.en: a series of events that happen in a particular order and repeat

sentences.en: The water cycle includes rain.
sentences.zh: 水循环包括降雨。

sentences.en: Climate change can disrupt the natural water cycle, increasing the frequency of droughts and floods in some regions.
sentences.zh: 气候变化会扰乱自然水循环，使一些地区的干旱和洪水更频繁。

meaning.en: The activity of riding a bicycle for transport or exercise.

sentences.en: We go cycling beside the river every Sunday morning.
sentences.zh: 我们每个星期天早上都沿河骑自行车。

sentences.en: Investing in safe cycling routes can encourage commuters to choose healthier and less polluting forms of transport.
sentences.zh: 投资建设安全的自行车道可以鼓励通勤者选择更健康、污染更少的交通方式。

meaning.en: a person who rides a bicycle

sentences.en: The cyclist stopped by the bridge to drink some water.
sentences.zh: 那位骑自行车的人在桥边停下来喝水。

sentences.en: Protected cycle lanes can reduce the risk of collisions between cyclists and motor vehicles in busy cities.
sentences.zh: 在繁忙的城市中，有隔离设施的自行车道可以降低骑车者与机动车碰撞的风险。

meaning.en: a violent tropical storm with strong spinning winds

sentences.en: A cyclone hit the island.
sentences.zh: 一场气旋袭击了这座岛。

sentences.en: The cyclone destroyed hundreds of homes along the coast.
sentences.zh: 这场气旋摧毁了沿海数百座房屋。

meaning.en: a solid shape with straight parallel sides and a circular or oval cross-section

sentences.en: The tank is a metal cylinder.
sentences.zh: 这个罐子是一个金属圆柱体。

sentences.en: The engine has four cylinders.
sentences.zh: 这个发动机有四个气缸。

meaning.zh: 愤世嫉俗的；认为人皆自私的
meaning.en: believing that people are motivated mainly by self-interest and are not sincere

sentences.en: He is cynical about kind words.
sentences.zh: 他对甜言蜜语持怀疑态度，认为人们并非真心。

sentences.en: Repeatedly broken promises can make citizens cynical about whether political leaders genuinely intend to improve public services.
sentences.zh: 一再失信会让公民怀疑政治领导人是否真心打算改善公共服务。
